Do not use stage, grade, TNM, treatment, recurrence, performance status, deprivation, centre, symptoms, screening invitation, GP visits, number of encounters, histology, adjudicated diagnosis date, or cause of death: they are unavailable.

## 4. Estimand and selection/recording falsification

For cancer class g in {CRC, nonCRC} and recordability stratum a in {0,1+}, define d_g(a) as the standardized short-lag reserve contrast:
P(Y=1 | g,A=a,R=Q25) minus P(Y=1 | g,A=a,R=Q75).

Q25/Q75 are fit on training data only. Standardize over the locked eligible case covariate distribution, with age, sex, BMI, smoking, year, Charlson, subsite, and missingness held to that distribution. The primary CRC-specific contrast is D = sum_a w_a [d_CRC(a)-d_nonCRC(a)], with w_a equal to eligible-case stratum proportions fixed before test inspection. Report all four d_g(a), D, and the ascertainment interaction S = [d_CRC(1+)-d_nonCRC(1+)] - [d_CRC(0)-d_nonCRC(0)].

This is a standardized association among recorded cases. It does not estimate an association in all assessed people because the denominator of unrecorded cancers is not observed.

The first-class selection/recording falsification is locked before fitting:

1. Report four cell-specific risks and contrasts, event counts, overlap, and reserve availability by g, A, lag, and channel_concordance.
2. Repeat with continuous A, with A in the adjustment model, and with stabilized inverse-probability-of-observation weights for reserve availability estimated among all assessment-window participants from age, sex, BMI, smoking, and A. Weights are a sensitivity, not a cure for UKB volunteer selection or MNAR missingness.
3. Repeat at 365 and 1,460 days and report continuous lag. A signal confined to the shortest lag, to A>=1, or to concordant clinical-code records supports occult timing/recordability rather than durable CRC-specific reserve.
4. Compare CRC with all non-CRC, other digestive, and non-digestive cancers when cell support permits. A similar reserve-by-lag pattern in non-CRC, or a large S, weakens CRC specificity.
5. Repeat paired 40005/40006 anchoring against the earliest usable concordant 41270/41280 C18–C20 or comparator occurrence. Material instability is adverse to a recording interpretation. Do not claim either channel is the true onset date.
6. Perform one fixed-seed reserve permutation within sex and one fixed-seed outcome permutation. Any held-out signal after permutation indicates leakage or implementation failure.
7. Record the follow-up readiness failure and do not fit incidence, mortality, censoring, or “no cancer” outcomes.

A positive D that persists in both A strata, across lag cutoffs, coding sensitivity, and missingness sensitivity is supportive of a CRC-specific recorded-case timing regularity. It still does not establish biology or causal reserve. A null or reversed D, a common non-CRC pattern, a recordability-stratum-only signal, channel instability, or a shortest-lag-only signal is adverse to the durable CRC-specific interpretation and supports selection, coding, or occult disease. Sparse cells, poor overlap, wide intervals, or contradictory channel definitions are inconclusive, not a null.

## 5. Scalar baseline versus substantive learned alternative

This comparison tests whether a scalar reserve score masks clinically meaningful component-by-cancer-class interactions after recordability stratification. It is not a leaderboard and predictive improvement alone cannot support the hypothesis.

Use one deterministic participant split, seed 36, 70/15/15 train/validation/locked test, assigned by eid hash before outcome rows are created and stratified only after assignment by cancer class, timing bin, assessment year, and A. No participant crosses splits. Fit transformations, imputations, Q25/Q75, weights, and tuning on training/validation only; inspect the locked test once.

- B0 covariate baseline: pooled binary logistic regression for Y with cancer class, age restricted cubic spline, sex, BMI, smoking, assessment year, pre-t0 Charlson, broad subsite, A, component-count/missingness indicators, and prespecified class-by-A interaction. It makes timing and ascertainment adjustment transparent.
- B1 scalar-reserve baseline: B0 plus one standardized linear R term and prespecified R-by-cancer-class and R-by-A terms. Derive d_g(a), D, and S from standardized model predictions.
- B2 learned component alternative: CPU gradient-boosted binary classifier on exactly the B1 participant rows and base covariates, replacing scalar-only reserve representation with the four transformed components, count/missingness indicators, explicit component-by-cancer-class and component-by-A products, and prespecified shallow interactions. Fixed grid: 200/400 trees, depth 2/3, learning rate 0.03/0.05; select once on validation log loss and Brier score. Report held-out accumulated-local-effect tables and permutation importance only as descriptive patterns.

The substantive learned output is not best AUC. For each component and cancer class, report standardized predicted-risk contrast across its training-defined interquartile range, the CRC-minus-non-CRC interaction, and the corresponding interaction by A, with participant-bootstrap intervals. Treat an interaction as an operational candidate only if its absolute risk difference is at least 0.05, its 95% interval excludes zero, it is directionally stable at 365/730/1,460-day cutoffs and in both A strata, and the model is calibrated. This 0.05 screen is a predeclared clinical-review trigger, not proof of utility.

Report held-out calibration intercept/slope, Brier score/log loss, one-vs-rest AUC as secondary, class/stratum event counts, D, S, component interactions, and paired participant-bootstrap intervals (at least 500 resamples; target 1,000). A small B2 predictive gain without a stable component-by-cancer contrast is not a substantive advance. A stable B1 association with no B2 gain remains informative that the scalar is adequate.

The actual scientific deliverable is complete only when newly fitted outputs include: (1) one-row-per-case audit table with eid excluded from public outputs, b_i, t0_i, paired-slot status, class/subsite, lag, Y, reserve components, A, channel concordance, covariates, and exclusion reason; (2) locked split manifest and fitted B0/B1/B2 objects; (3) test predictions, calibration, Brier/log-loss, d_g(a), D, S, component interactions, and bootstrap intervals; and (4) a falsification report mapping every conclusion to an output.

## 6. Alternatives and resource decision

The scalar case-only baseline is retained because it is the smallest interpretable estimator of the target contrast and exposes age/comorbidity and ascertainment strata. The learned component model is retained because grip, albumin, creatinine, and cystatin C can plausibly carry different CRC/non-CRC timing information; their vector and class interactions are erased by averaging them into R. A sequence/transformer model is deferred: no dated repeated reserve trajectory or encounter stream is bound. # UKB-672073 diagnosis-anchored CRC timing: recordability-controlled repair

Status: proposed, not fitted. Parent: candidate-7508a649e73cc544ca5959e0. This is a substantive repair of the parent’s remaining ascertainment/selection objection. It does not restore the unsupported mortality or population-incidence endpoint.

## 1. Opening, supported claim, and hypothesis

The inspected evidence supports three bounded observations. A mixed oncology cohort reported that a patient-reported/comorbidity frailty index was associated with survival after cancer diagnosis [K1]. A longitudinal immune study reported physiological change up to four years before some cancer diagnoses, making occult disease timing a serious rival to any reserve interpretation [K2]. A Swedish register study shows what stage, treatment and national-register follow-up can add, but those elements are not in the verified UKB binding [K3]. None tests pre-assessment reserve against CRC diagnosis lag or separates that pattern from generic recordability.

The strongest claim supported by the parent is only: among people with a subsequently recorded cancer, lower assessment-time reserve may be associated with shorter lag to that recorded diagnosis, with a CRC-versus-non-CRC contrast. This is not incidence, true diagnosis time, screening performance, stage, treatment tolerance, mortality, causality or mechanism.

The strongest unresolved rival is a recording process. Lower reserve/comorbidity may increase healthcare contact and opportunities for cancer coding; conditioning on ever having a recorded cancer may select on this process. The observed pattern could therefore be generic documentation timing, cancer-register ascertainment, unmeasured symptoms, or selection rather than CRC-specific biology.

**Repaired hypothesis:** among UKB participants with a valid 2006–2010 assessment and an observed paired cancer diagnosis after assessment, the CRC-versus-non-CRC near-assessment lag contrast associated with lower measured reserve remains after standardizing by pre-assessment dated non-cancer diagnosis history, and is not reproduced by a same-source negative-control timing endpoint for first recorded non-cancer diagnoses. This is a robustness claim about documented records, not a causal reserve or healthcare-contact effect.

Generic recordability predicts similar reserve-by-short-lag associations in CRC, non-CRC and non-cancer records, and attenuation after pre-assessment record-history stratification. Cancer-specific/occult timing predicts a larger CRC contrast, concentration near diagnosis, and weaker replication in controls. Neither result identifies mechanism because encounters, symptoms, referral, screening, true diagnosis dates and completeness are unavailable.

Clinical advance: a positive result would justify a future outcome-complete cohort with encounter, symptom, stage and treatment data; a control-like result would prevent a recordability signal from being misrepresented as a CRC biological detector.

[K1] motivates reserve but is post-diagnosis/mixed-cancer; [K2] motivates occult timing; [K3] bounds the missing registry evidence.

## 2. Exact UKB binding

with quartiles fixed in training. Primary estimand:
`D_contact=sum_h w_h(A_CRC,h-A_nonCRC,h)`,

This still is not population risk, causal effect, true diagnosis delay or contact-adjusted biology.

### Same-source negative control

Construct a separate observed-event sample from `41270/41280`: no observed pre-assessment C00–C97 record in either history, earliest valid post-`b_i` paired code/date not C00–C97, `0<L^{NC}<=1825`, valid reserve/covariates; `Y^{NC}=1` for <730 days. ## 4. Baseline, learned alternative and deliverable

The actual deliverable is newly fitted `D_contact`, `A_NC`, class-by-reserve interactions, H support/overlap, source concordance, locked uncertainty and interpretation outputs. No fit is claimed here.

Use one eid-hash split, seed 36, 70/15/15 train/validation/locked test, assigned before row construction and shared across primary/NC rows. Fit transformations, imputation, reserve quartiles, H weights, tuning and thresholds without locked-test inspection.

- B0: interpretable multinomial logistic regression for CRC-short, CRC-long, nonCRC-short, nonCRC-long with age spline, sex, BMI, smoking, year, Charlson, H category and subsite where defined.
- B1: B0 plus one-SD R, component count/missingness, reserve-by-class and reserve-by-H interactions; a separate same-form NC model estimates A_NC.
- B2: CPU gradient-boosted multinomial model on the same one-row-per-participant primary inputs and split, adding four reserve components, R, H count/category/indicator, baseline covariates and prespecified reserve-by-class/H interactions. B2 is retained because B1 compresses H to categories and reserve to a scalar; B2 can reveal stable component thresholds or H-by-class concentration. It is not selected for a small predictive gain. Report held-out calibration, Brier/log loss, secondary class AUC, `D_contact`, `A_NC`, interaction contrasts, component permutation importance and descriptive accumulated-local-effect tables. ## 5. Falsification and interpretation

Run once under the frozen specification and retain adverse results.

1. H-stratified `A_g,h`: disappearance, reversal or lack of overlap after H standardization supports selection/recordability.
2. Same-source NC: an `A_NC` similar to CRC and unified interaction supports generic documentation timing; sparse NC is inconclusive.
3. Alternate `41270/41280` anchor: material class/date disagreement or changed `D_contact` is adverse.
4. Occult timing: repeat 365 and 1460 days and continuous lag. Short-window-only signal supports diagnostic proximity/occult disease, not durable reserve.
5. CRC specificity: compare other digestive and non-digestive cancers when supported; similar controls weaken specificity.
6. Age/comorbidity/measurement: age-only, age-plus-Charlson, flexible-age, complete-four, min-three, grip-only and lab-only fits; attenuation is confounding/selection/measurement evidence, not mechanism.
7. Coding/leakage: retain all slot audits; permute reserve within sex and labels once with fixed seeds. Any permutation signal invalidates the fit.
8. Follow-up: state `tau_source` failed; do not fit mortality, use no-record as no-event, or use `20191-0.0` as a cutoff.

# UKB diagnosis-anchored CRC timing: temporal record-history state transition child

Status: proposed, not fitted. Child of candidate-a403c72d4e353a7f9c5b0237. This is a complementary formulation of the documented-record question; it does not restore the failed mortality/incidence endpoint, convert diagnosis dates into encounter dates, or claim a fitted result.

## 1. Scientific opening and claim boundary

The inherited proposal makes the strongest available claim deliberately narrow: among people with a valid 2006–2010 assessment and a subsequently observed paired cancer record, lower assessment-time reserve may be associated with a shorter lag to that recorded diagnosis, with a CRC-versus-other-cancer contrast. Its dated non-cancer history count H is a useful control, but H compresses a temporally ordered record history into one scalar. A person with one recent code and a person with ten remote codes can have similar or different H categories despite very different observable record histories.

The unresolved question is whether the reserve-by-lag contrast is specific to CRC timing after representing the *temporal state of recorded diagnosis history*, or whether it is a general transition-to-documentation pattern. This matters clinically because a positive CRC-specific temporal contrast could justify an encounter-complete study of prediagnostic vulnerability and diagnostic proximity; a contrast that follows generic history recency/repetition would warn against presenting reserve as a CRC biological detector or screening signal.

Evidence already supports, but does not prove, three boundaries. [K1] reports a post-diagnosis mixed-oncology frailty-survival association. [K2] makes occult disease a plausible rival by reporting physiological change years before some cancer diagnoses. [K3] shows that stage, treatment and complete register follow-up can materially bound CRC interpretation, but those fields are not in this UKB binding. None establishes a CRC-specific prediagnostic reserve-to-recorded-lag mechanism.

The leading explanation is occult CRC or diagnostic proximity: lower reserve may be closer to an underlying CRC process, so its association should concentrate in CRC and the shortest lag window. The consequential rival is recordability: recent/recurrent documented diagnoses mark a participant whose conditions are more likely to generate coding opportunities, so reserve may associate with short lags for CRC, other cancer and non-cancer diagnoses alike. Age, comorbidity, symptoms, referral, screening and coding differences can produce either pattern. This experiment can separate observable timing patterns, not prove mechanism, healthcare contact, true disease onset or causality.

Hypothesis: conditional on an observed post-assessment paired diagnosis-history event, the reserve contrast in near-assessment lag is larger for first recorded CRC than for first recorded non-cancer diagnoses after standardizing to the same pre-assessment temporal history states; the CRC excess is concentrated in the near window and is not explained by the history-state gradient. If the contrast is equal across classes or disappears after state representation, generic recordability is the better-supported explanation.

[
A_{g,s}=P(L<730mid G=g,S=s,R=Q25)-P(L<730mid G=g,S=s,R=Q75),

Positive (D_{mathrm{temp}}) means lower observed reserve is more associated with near-assessment *recorded CRC* than near-assessment *recorded non-cancer diagnosis* after standardizing the observable temporal history state. It does not mean a causal reserve effect, true onset timing, symptom duration, or healthcare-contact-adjusted biology.

The baseline loses information in two ways: it treats recency and repetition as interchangeable within H categories, and it asks the CRC/non-CRC contrast using different event representations. The temporal alternative retains the order-relevant information that is actually available—whether documentation was absent, remote, recent once, or recurrent recently—and constructs CRC, other-cancer and non-cancer transitions from the same `41270/41280` source. It therefore tests whether a CRC-specific reserve-by-lag pattern survives a common-source, state-conditioned comparison. ## 5. Baseline, mechanistic alternative, split and uncertainty

The actual deliverable is newly computed, output-linked: cohort flow and malformed/tied-slot audit; state support and overlap; class-by-state-by-window counts; (A_{g,s}), (D_{mathrm{temp}}) and uncertainty; a source-concordance table against `40005/40006`; held-out calibration and scoring; and a supportive/adverse/inconclusive interpretation linked to those outputs. Assign participants before event-row construction; all rows from an `eid) remain in one split. B0 — scalar recordability baseline:

- six-category multinomial logistic regression for (Y);

Before any fit, report:

1. exact source paths, hashes, table IDs, archive members, namespace and selected columns;
2. paired-slot parseability, malformed code/date, duplicate code/date, pre-cancer exclusion and earliest-event tie counts;
3. support for every (G	imes S	imes) near/late cell and CRC/NC overlap in each state;
4. reserve component availability and missingness by class/state;
5. agreement of the same-source CRC class/date with the earliest valid paired `40005/40006` record when available, exact-date and +/-30-day concordance;
6. no use of `20191-0.0` as a censoring or completeness cutoff.

Primary state support is adequate only if every required CRC and NC state/window cell has at least 30 participants in the analysis population and every fitted train/validation/locked cell is nonempty. If a state fails this gate, do not merge states after inspection; report the design as inconclusive. A predeclared fallback may be run once: combine S=2 and S=3 as “recent,” retaining S=0 and S=1, only if that combined cell and all class/window cells pass the same support rule. Otherwise stop before fitting.

Falsification and boundary checks are fixed in advance:

- **Temporal specificity:** repeat near cutoffs at 365 and 730 days and late cutoffs at 1460 days. A CRC contrast confined to the shortest window supports diagnostic proximity/occult timing, not durable reserve.
- **Generic recordability:** compare (A_{mathrm{CRC},s}), (A_{mathrm{other cancer},s}) and (A_{mathrm{NC},s}) within state. Similar slopes or a state gradient shared across classes support documentation selection.
- **State attenuation:** compare B0 H-category and B1 temporal-state estimates. Strong attenuation or reversal after recency/repetition representation is adverse to a scalar-reserve CRC interpretation; it does not prove an encounter mechanism.
- **Source concordance:** material CRC class/date disagreement or a materially changed contrast when `40005/40006` is used as a sensitivity anchor is adverse. Concordance is not adjudication or independent validation.
- **Confounding/measurement:** age-only, age-plus-Charlson, complete-four, minimum-three, grip-only and laboratory-only reserve fits; attenuation identifies confounding, selection or measurement dependence, not mechanism.
- **Coding:** report all tie, unpaired, malformed and non-ICD-normalizable slots; any reserve signal after one fixed within-state label permutation invalidates the corresponding computation.
- **Selection:** compare eligible event-conditioned participants with all dated assessment participants on available age, sex, BMI, smoking, year and component availability. No inverse-probability analysis can repair missing-not-at-random event observation without an outcome-complete sampling model.

Supportive results require passed readiness, adequate CRC/NC overlap, a positive (D_{mathrm{temp}}) with a 95% interval excluding zero, a larger and near-window-concentrated CRC contrast than NC in supported states, no comparable other-cancer/NC pattern, stable source concordance, and no permutation signal. This supports only a robust association among observed diagnosis-history transitions.

Adverse results are state-adjusted attenuation/reversal, similar CRC/other-cancer/NC contrasts, source instability, a signal only in the shortest window, one reserve component or missingness rule driving the result, or permutation leakage. These support generic recordability, occult timing, coding or selection and should abandon or narrow a durable CRC-reserve interpretation.

Inconclusive results are failed state overlap, sparse ties or events, wide intervals, unstable source pairing, failed calibration, failed bootstrap, or any provenance/readiness gate failure. An imprecise null is not refutation. Continuation would require encounter-level dates, symptom/referral/screening information, ascertainment-complete linkage, stage, treatment, clinical diagnosis-date adjudication or an independent cohort.

A full dated disease-history sequence model is deferred: the available arrays are sparse paired diagnosis fields without encounter provenance, symptom context or a verified complete observation process. Sequence learning could recover ordering, but it cannot distinguish an undocumented encounter from no encounter and would add model complexity without resolving the central uncertainty. Revisit it only if encounter-level dated data are admitted or if B1 demonstrates reproducible temporal structure that a longer validated history can test. Multi-omics and mechanistic biology are also deferred because no validated molecular CRC endpoint, stage, histology, treatment or independent clinical outcome is bound to this question.

Computationally checkable: source hashes and schemas, namespace-safe joins, paired parsing, state construction, event-class/lag targets, support gates, model fitting, locked predictions, calibration, bootstrap intervals and whether conclusions match outputs. # Evolution repair: narrow the CRC timing estimand to paired observed records

Status: proposed, not fitted. Parent: candidate-a403c72d4e353a7f9c5b0237. This is a substantive child repair motivated by an exact-schema audit and an unsuccessful bounded support probe. It preserves the failed \`tau_source\` boundary, the \`ukb672073\` namespace, the five exact Parquet bindings, and the inherited three-work abstract-only evidence receipts.

## Decision in this episode

The 41270/41280 construct is usable as a dated diagnosis-history variable, but it is not validated as healthcare contact, encounter frequency, ascertainment completeness, or recordability truth. The catalog proves that it has 259 paired code/date slots; it does not prove that the slots are complete or that the number of dated codes measures contact. The attempted bounded aggregate support pass exceeded the 120-second shell limit before emitting results, so no H-category overlap or event counts are treated as observed.

Therefore I do not retain the parent’s H-standardized contrast as the primary claim. The child narrows the estimand to the directly observable, diagnosis-anchored comparison and uses 41270/41280 as a prespecified second representation of the same recorded diagnosis. H remains a secondary descriptive/gated diagnostic. If its CRC/non-CRC cells fail overlap, the H analysis stops as inconclusive; it cannot rescue or invalidate the primary observed-record comparison.

## 1. Scientific opening, supported claim, unresolved claim

The inherited inspected evidence supports three bounded points. [K1] reports an association between a patient-reported/comorbidity frailty construct and survival in a mixed oncology setting; it is post-diagnosis and does not establish a pre-assessment CRC timing effect. [K2] reports physiological change in the years before some cancer diagnoses, making occult disease or diagnostic proximity a serious rival to a reserve interpretation. [K3] is a Swedish national-register colorectal-cancer study whose complete registry, stage/treatment and follow-up infrastructure are not present in this UKB binding. All three are inherited abstract-only inspections; no inaccessible full text or supplement is claimed.

The strongest claim supported by the parent is only descriptive: among people with a subsequently recorded cancer, assessment-time reserve may be associated with the lag to that recorded diagnosis, possibly differently for CRC and non-CRC. It is not incidence, a true diagnosis date, screening performance, encounter frequency, stage, treatment tolerance, mortality, causality or mechanism.

The unresolved question is narrower and falsifiable:

> Among UKB participants assessed from 2006 through 2010 who have an observed paired cancer record within five years, is lower assessment-time measured reserve associated with a higher probability of a CRC diagnosis being recorded within 730 days rather than 730–1825 days, and does that CRC-versus-non-CRC timing contrast replicate when the first valid post-assessment 41270/41280 record is used as the diagnosis representation?

A CRC-specific and source-replicated contrast would support a robust association with the timing of recorded CRC among recorded cases. A comparable non-CRC contrast, source disagreement, or a signal confined to <730 days would support recordability/selection, coding instability, or occult diagnostic proximity rather than a durable reserve interpretation. No possible result identifies the mechanism.

Clinical advance: the result determines whether a pre-assessment reserve signal merits an outcome-complete validation study or should be abandoned as an ascertainment-sensitive artifact. It does not change screening or treatment.

## 2. Exact source audit and immutable boundaries

## 3. Population and observable variables

Set \(b_i\) to parsed \`53-0.0\`; retain \(2006\text{-}01\text{-}01 \le b_i \le 2010\text{-}12\text{-}31\). A primary diagnosis slot is valid only if the same slot has a parseable \`40005-k.0\` date and a nonempty normalized ICD-10 \`40006-k.0\` code. Never borrow a code or date from a neighboring slot. Use the observed-case population:

1. Exclude a participant only when an observed paired C00–C97 record on or before \(b_i\) is present in either 40005/40006 or 41270/41280. This is not true cancer-free status.
2. Select the earliest valid post-\(b_i\) C00–C97 40005/40006 record as \(t^{40005}_i\).

Covariates are age \`21022-0.0\`, sex \`31-0.0\`, BMI \`21001-0.0\`, smoking \`20116-0.0\`, assessment year, cancer class/subsite and a dated pre-\(t_0\) Charlson count from paired 41270/41280 codes, excluding the incident cancer. \`34-0.0\` is a calendar audit only.

## 4. Estimands and recordability diagnostic

For source \(s\in\{40005,412\}\), cancer group \(g\in\{CRC,nonCRC\}\), and reserve value \(r\), estimate
\[
 A^s_g=P(Y^s=1\mid g,R=Q25)-P(Y^s=1\mid g,R=Q75).
\]
The primary observable estimand is
\[
 D_{40005}=A^{40005}_{CRC}-A^{40005}_{nonCRC}.
\]
The replication estimand is \(D_{412}=A^{412}_{CRC}-A^{412}_{nonCRC}\), reported with its eligible-case count and source-availability selection. Report the difference \(D_{40005}-D_{412}\), component-specific contrasts, continuous lag and 365/730/1460-day window checks with participant-bootstrap 95% intervals. Positive values mean lower reserve is more associated with an earlier *recorded* CRC diagnosis than an earlier recorded nonCRC diagnosis. They do not mean earlier biological diagnosis, healthcare contact, incidence or causation.

Retain the parent’s H definition only as a secondary diagnostic: from same-slot 41270/41280 pairs with nonempty code and parseable date in \([1900\text{-}01\text{-}01,b_i)\), deduplicate exact code/date pairs, exclude C00–C97, and define H categories 0, 1, 2–4, >=5. Report H support and CRC/nonCRC overlap before any H-stratified model. H is a dated diagnosis-history count, not contact, encounter frequency, completeness, symptom burden or referral.

The H diagnostic has a hard admissibility rule: every primary H stratum used in a contrast must have both cancer groups and prespecified minimum support documented in the readiness output; otherwise no H-adjusted estimate is interpreted. A failed or timed-out support scan is not evidence of overlap. If admissible, report H-stratified \(A_g\) and a locked H-distribution standardization as a sensitivity only. If H adjustment materially changes D40005 or if H patterns are similar across CRC/nonCRC, the result supports recordability/selection concerns and narrows the interpretation to the observable diagnosis-lag association.

## 5. Baseline, learned alternative and actual deliverable

The actual deliverable is newly fitted, output-linked \(D_{40005}\), \(D_{412}\), source availability/concordance, H support diagnostics, window sensitivities, calibrated predictions and participant-bootstrap uncertainty. No fitted result is claimed in this draft.

Use one deterministic \`eid\`-hash split, seed 36, 70/15/15 train/validation/locked test, assigned before construction of either source representation. Keep participants in one split across all rows and representations. Fit all transformations, imputation, reserve quartiles, tuning and thresholds without locked-test inspection.

- **B0 interpretable baseline:** multinomial logistic regression for CRC-short, CRC-long, nonCRC-short, nonCRC-long, using prespecified age spline, sex, BMI, smoking, assessment year, Charlson count, cancer class/subsite and missingness/availability indicators. - **B1 interpretable reserve model:** B0 plus one-SD \(R\), reserve component count/missingness, and prespecified reserve-by-cancer-class interactions. The coefficient and predicted Q25-versus-Q75 contrasts directly estimate the scientific quantities.
- **B2 substantive learned alternative:** CPU gradient-boosted multinomial model on the same one-row-per-participant inputs and split, adding the four reserve components, \(R\), missingness, H count/category when available, baseline covariates, cancer class/subsite and prespecified reserve-by-class/H interactions. B2 is scientifically informative only if it reveals stable component thresholds, source-specific timing structure or H-by-class concentration that B1’s scalar reserve and categories lose. A small predictive gain alone does not justify the alternative. Baseline-versus-learned resource estimate: CPU 2–4 cores, 8–16 GiB, approximately 20–40 minutes after selected-column reads; this fit estimate is unverified. GPU is not required for these tabular fits. The hardware audit identifies A100 capacity but ordinary shells have no allocation; no GPU was requested because device choice does not affect this bounded tabular design. A future sequence model is deferred because the question is resolved first by paired observable timing and the verified data do not establish complete dated trajectories or encounter provenance.

## 6. Falsification and interpretation

Run once under the frozen specification; retain all adverse results.

1. **Source replication:** materially different direction, class assignment or date difference between 40005/40006 and 41270/41280 is adverse to a stable record-timing interpretation. Exact and ±30-day concordance are descriptive representation checks, not adjudication.
2. **Control behavior:** if H is admissible and H-stratified reserve slopes are similar for CRC and nonCRC, or the contrast disappears after H sensitivity standardization, support generic recordability/selection. If H support fails, report inconclusive and do not call the absence of adjustment evidence.
3. **Window behavior:** a contrast only in <365 or <730 days supports diagnostic proximity/occult disease; a directionally stable effect through 1460 days is more consistent with a durable observed-case timing regularity but still not mechanism.
4. **Specificity:** compare other digestive and non-digestive cancer groups only when their paired-code support is adequate and frozen before fitting. Similar patterns weaken CRC specificity.
5. **Confounding and measurement:** age-only, age-plus-Charlson, flexible-age, complete-four, minimum-three, grip-only and laboratory-only sensitivities. Attenuation is evidence of confounding, selection or measurement dependence, not proof of mechanism.
6. **Coding/leakage:** report all malformed/unpaired/duplicate/discordant slots; perform one fixed-seed reserve permutation within sex and label permutation. Held-out signal under permutation invalidates the computation.
7. **Follow-up boundary:** retain \`tau_source\` failed. Do not fit mortality, use \`20191-0.0\` as a cutoff, or treat no cancer record as cancer-free/no event.

Supportive results require adequate counts and overlap, positive D40005 with an interval excluding zero, a directionally compatible D412 in a prespecified eligible representation, no comparable nonCRC/control pattern, no material coding instability, and no permutation leakage. This supports only a robust association with timing of recorded CRC diagnoses among recorded cases.

Adverse results are H attenuation, comparable CRC/nonCRC slopes, source instability, shortest-window-only behavior, one-component dependence, or disappearance after age/comorbidity/missingness. These support recordability, selection, occult timing or measurement and abandon a durable reserve interpretation.

Inconclusive results are sparse or non-overlapping H cells, too few CRC/nonCRC cases, wide intervals, failed pair parsing, low source concordance, poor calibration, or readiness failure. An imprecise null is not refutation. A_{g,s}=P(L<730mid G=g,S=s,R=Q25)-P(L<730mid G=g,S=s,R=Q75)

- **B0 scalar recordability baseline:** six-category multinomial logistic regression for `Y), with age spline, sex, BMI, smoking, assessment year, scalar reserve (R), component count/missingness, and parent `H_cat` (0, 1, 2–4, >=5 pre-assessment non-cancer pairs), plus pre-specified reserve-by-class and reserve-by-H interactions.
- **B2 inflammation/state alternative:** the identical participant split and six-category target; use temporal state `S), days since latest pre-assessment non-cancer pair, recent unique-date count, the four reserve components and missingness, and `log1p(CRP)) plus a CRP-missing indicator. Add only the pre-specified state-by-event-class and CRP-by-event-class-by-window terms needed for (D_mathrm{CRP}). Fit multinomially and compute contrasts from locked predictions. A neural sequence model is deferred because it cannot repair undocumented encounters and would add complexity without the missing observation process.

Split participants deterministically by hash of `eid), seed 36: 70% train, 15% validation, 15% locked test; assign before event-row construction. All rows for an `eid) stay together. The raw genomics sensitivity is unverified and may require a separate 4–8-core, 32–64 GiB, <=2 h selected-column scan; do not silently replace it with the easier CRP arm if it fails.

Predeclare:

- **Temporal specificity:** repeat fixed 365/730/1460-day boundaries. CRC-specific (D_mathrm{CRP}) concentrated near assessment supports timing-compatible biology, not true onset.
- **Generic recordability:** compare CRC, other-cancer and non-cancer (B_{g,s}). Similar gradients across classes, or a large state gradient with little class separation, favors documentation/selection.
- **State attenuation:** compare B0 and B2. Attenuation/reversal after S and CRP is adverse to a scalar reserve interpretation; it does not prove encounters.
- **Biological specificity:** a CRC-versus-NC CRP contrast with no comparable other-cancer contrast supports a disease-specific association. CRP-only or missingness-only effects are adverse to a biological reading.
- **Measurement/selection:** complete-four versus minimum-three reserve, grip-only and laboratory-only versions; report whether CRP availability drives class/state differences. No inverse-probability model repairs missing-not-at-random outcome observation without an outcome-complete sampling model.
- **Coding/source:** report unpaired, malformed, duplicate and same-date ties; repeat with fixed within-state class-label permutation. Any corresponding permuted signal invalidates the computation.
- **Source concordance:** compare CRC class/date with earliest valid paired `40005/40006`; material disagreement is adverse, concordance is not adjudication.

Supportive results require all gates, stable source concordance, calibrated locked predictions, a positive (D_mathrm{temp}) and CRC-specific (D_mathrm{CRP}) with intervals excluding zero, larger than NC/other-cancer contrasts and concentrated in near windows, with no permutation signal. This supports a robust association among recorded transitions compatible with occult biological timing.

Adverse results are similar CRC/other-cancer/NC CRP gradients, state attenuation/reversal, instability under missingness or source pairing, shortest-window-only signal, or permutation leakage. They support generic recordability, measurement, coding or selection and should narrow or abandon a reserve/inflammation interpretation.

Inconclusive results are failed support, sparse complete-case CRP, wide intervals, failed calibration/bootstrap, material source disagreement or raw-genomic readiness failure. An imprecise null is not refutation. Continuing the direction requires encounter-level dates, symptom/referral/screening data, ascertainment-complete linkage, adjudicated diagnosis onset, stage, treatment or independent replication.

Computationally checkable: source hashes/table schemas, namespace-safe joins, CRP availability, paired-slot parsing, temporal states, event-conditioned target, support gates, locked model outputs, calibration, bootstrap intervals and whether conclusions match those outputs.

Requires clinical adjudication or another study: actual encounter completeness, symptom onset, referral/screening, true cancer onset, stage, treatment, mechanism, causal effect, mortality/incidence and external validity. The follow-up field `20191-0.0` cannot establish any of these.

## Alternatives not chosen and revisit criteria

- Olink/proteomic augmentation: blocked until a documented `olink_dta)-to-`ukb672073) crosswalk is admitted; do not revisit merely because row counts look similar.
- Raw CRC PRS arm: revisit only after selected-column parseability, value distribution, participant overlap and every class/state/window support gate pass. Its result would test inherited susceptibility, not encounter completeness.
- Neural sequence model: revisit only if encounter-level dated histories or a validated observation process is admitted, or if B2 produces a reproducible temporal/biomarker pattern that a longer history can independently test.
- Mortality/incidence analysis: remains explicitly out of scope unless complete outcome and censoring provenance are admitted.

[K1] Mathew D et al., “Development and application of a frailty index derived from patient-reported outcome measures and comorbidities in oncology patients.” Internal Medicine Journal, 2026, DOI 10.1111/imj.70599. Abstract-only. It bounds post-diagnosis frailty-survival associations and does not establish prediagnostic timing or recordability.

[K2] Chen G et al., “Age-dependent cytokine surge in blood precedes cancer diagnosis.” PNAS, 2025, DOI 10.1073/pnas.2420502122. Abstract-only. It supports occult biological timing as a plausible rival, but is not CRC-specific and has no contact measure.

[K3] Lu SSM et al., “Prediagnostic Prescription Antibiotics Use and Survival in Patients with Colorectal Cancer: A Swedish National Register-Based Study.” Cancer Epidemiology, Biomarkers & Prevention, 2023, DOI 10.1158/1055-9965.epi-23-0340. Abstract-only. It demonstrates what stage/treatment/complete registers could add, none of which is bound here.

Receipts and exact UTF-8 inspected excerpts are attached separately. These references were reused unchanged from the parent; no inaccessible full text or supplementary method is claimed.

## Population and temporal boundary

Use the parent population unchanged:

1. Parse `b_i=53-0.0`; retain `2006-01-01 <= b_i <= 2010-12-31), unique `eid), valid sex/age/BMI/smoking, and at least three of the four reserve components.
2. Exclude any observed paired C00–C97 record on or before `b_i) in either `40005/40006` or `41270/41280`. This is no observed pre-assessment cancer record, not cancer-free status.
3. Construct `S_i) only from paired `41270/41280) non-cancer records before `b_i): none; remote-only (latest <=730 days before b); recent-single (one unique date in the prior 730 days); recurrent-recent (>=2 unique dates in the prior 730 days). Deduplicate exact code/date pairs and retain malformed/unpaired audit counts.
4. Scan paired post-assessment `41270/41280) through `b_i+1825). Use the earliest valid record, classify CRC (C18/C19/C20), other cancer (C00–C97 excluding C18–C20), or non-cancer; exclude same-date class ties from primary and report a fixed tie sensitivity. Retain only participants with an observed first event in the window.
5. Set `L=t_i-b_i), near `0<L<730), late `730<=L<=1825). Secondary fixed windows are 365 and 1460 days. The target remains `Y=(G, near/late)) and the population remains event-conditioned documented records. No participant without an observed event is assigned a non-event.

No incidence, absolute risk, hazard, mortality, censoring curve or population follow-up claim is permitted. `20191-0.0) is not a censoring/completeness boundary.

## Added biomarker estimand

Retain the parent primary:
[
A_{g,s}=P(L<730mid G=g,S=s,R=Q25)-P(L<730mid G=g,S=s,R=Q75)
]
and
[
D_mathrm{temp}=sum_s w_s(A_{mathrm{CRC},s}-A_{mathrm{NC},s}),
]
with locked event-conditioned state weights and participant-bootstrap intervals.

Add one pre-specified descriptive/mechanistic contrast. Transform CRP as `log1p(CRP)), fit the transform and training-derived quartiles on training data only, and define
[
B_{g,s}=P(L<730mid G=g,S=s,mathrm{CRP}=Q75,R=Q50)
 -P(L<730mid G=g,S=s,mathrm{CRP}=Q25,R=Q50),
]
[
D_mathrm{CRP}=sum_s w_s(B_{mathrm{CRC},s}-B_{mathrm{NC},s}).
]
Report (B_{g,s}), (D_mathrm{CRP}), the reserve-adjusted CRC-versus-other-cancer comparison, and missingness strata. This is a conditional documented-record contrast, not an effect of CRP or proof of occult onset. The primary claim remains the parent (D_mathrm{temp}); (D_mathrm{CRP}) is the selection/biology boundary.

Support gates are fixed before fitting: every required CRC and non-cancer state/window cell has >=30 participants; for the CRP arm, every corresponding complete-case cell has >=30 and a missing-CRP indicator cell is retained. If complete-case CRP support fails, report the CRP arm inconclusive and do not merge states after looking at outcomes. A one-time predeclared S=2/S=3 recent collapse is allowed only under the same support gate.

## Baseline versus substantive alternative

The actual deliverable is newly computed and output-linked: cohort flow and paired-slot audit; state/class/window support; CRP availability/missingness by state and class; (A_{g,s}), (D_mathrm{temp}), (B_{g,s}), (D_mathrm{CRP}) with uncertainty; source-concordance checks; locked predictions/calibration; and an interpretation tied to those outputs. No fitted result is asserted here.

- **B0 scalar recordability baseline:** six-category multinomial logistic regression for `Y), with age spline, sex, BMI, smoking, assessment year, scalar reserve (R), component count/missingness, and parent `H_cat` (0, 1, 2–4, >=5 pre-assessment non-cancer pairs), plus pre-specified reserve-by-class and reserve-by-H interactions.
- **B2 inflammation/state alternative:** the identical participant split and six-category target; use temporal state `S), days since latest pre-assessment non-cancer pair, recent unique-date count, the four reserve components and missingness, and `log1p(CRP)) plus a CRP-missing indicator. Add only the pre-specified state-by-event-class and CRP-by-event-class-by-window terms needed for (D_mathrm{CRP}). Fit multinomially and compute contrasts from locked predictions. A CRP signal that changes only a score is not a scientific success; it must alter (D_mathrm{CRP}), the CRC-versus-NC contrast, or its temporal concentration.
- **Deferred genomic sensitivity:** if raw `26218-0.0)/`26219-0.0` selected-column extraction passes the raw-file read, namespace, value, overlap and >=30-per-cell gates, add standard CRC PRS (primary) and enhanced CRC PRS (sensitivity only) as pre-assessment covariates with CRC-class-by-window interactions. Use no PRS feature selection. If it fails, omit the arm and preserve the failure. CAD/T2D PRS are not CRC substitutes.
- A shallow CPU gradient-boosted multinomial model on B2 inputs (fixed 200/400 trees, depth 2/3, learning rate .03/.05, validation log loss/Brier selection) is a learned sensitivity, not the primary scientific decision. It can reveal a reproducible threshold or interaction that B0/B2 linear terms miss; it cannot establish mechanism. A neural sequence model is deferred because it cannot repair undocumented encounters and would add complexity without the missing observation process.

Split participants deterministically by hash of `eid), seed 36: 70% train, 15% validation, 15% locked test; assign before event-row construction. All rows for an `eid) stay together. Balance only through the predeclared assignment rule, never by peeking at locked outcomes. Fit imputations, transforms, quartiles, state weights and tuning on training data only.

Uncertainty: at least 500 participant bootstrap resamples with split preserved; report successful refits and sparse-stratum failures. Locked-test multiclass Brier/log loss, calibration by class/window, one-vs-rest AUC, (D_mathrm{temp}), (D_mathrm{CRP}) and state-specific intervals are required. Resource plan: CPU 4–8 cores, 16–32 GiB RAM, <=2 h for the prepared Parquet experiment and bootstrap; no GPU needed. The raw genomics sensitivity is unverified and may require a separate 4–8-core, 32–64 GiB, <=2 h selected-column scan; do not silently replace it with the easier CRP arm if it fails.

## Falsification and interpretation

Predeclare:

- **Temporal specificity:** repeat fixed 365/730/1460-day boundaries. CRC-specific (D_mathrm{CRP}) concentrated near assessment supports timing-compatible biology, not true onset.
- **Generic recordability:** compare CRC, other-cancer and non-cancer (B_{g,s}). Similar gradients across classes, or a large state gradient with little class separation, favors documentation/selection.
- **State attenuation:** compare B0 and B2. Attenuation/reversal after S and CRP is adverse to a scalar reserve interpretation; it does not prove encounters.
- **Biological specificity:** a CRC-versus-NC CRP contrast with no comparable other-cancer contrast supports a disease-specific association. CRP-only or missingness-only effects are adverse to a biological reading.
- **Measurement/selection:** complete-four versus minimum-three reserve, grip-only and laboratory-only versions; report whether CRP availability drives class/state differences. No inverse-probability model repairs missing-not-at-random outcome observation without an outcome-complete sampling model.
- **Coding/source:** report unpaired, malformed, duplicate and same-date ties; repeat with fixed within-state class-label permutation. Any corresponding permuted signal invalidates the computation.
- **Source concordance:** compare CRC class/date with earliest valid paired `40005/40006`; material disagreement is adverse, concordance is not adjudication.

Supportive results require all gates, stable source concordance, calibrated locked predictions, a positive (D_mathrm{temp}) and CRC-specific (D_mathrm{CRP}) with intervals excluding zero, larger than NC/other-cancer contrasts and concentrated in near windows, with no permutation signal. This supports a robust association among recorded transitions compatible with occult biological timing.

Adverse results are similar CRC/other-cancer/NC CRP gradients, state attenuation/reversal, instability under missingness or source pairing, shortest-window-only signal, or permutation leakage. They support generic recordability, measurement, coding or selection and should narrow or abandon a reserve/inflammation interpretation.

Inconclusive results are failed support, sparse complete-case CRP, wide intervals, failed calibration/bootstrap, material source disagreement or raw-genomic readiness failure. An imprecise null is not refutation. Continuing the direction requires encounter-level dates, symptom/referral/screening data, ascertainment-complete linkage, adjudicated diagnosis onset, stage, treatment or independent replication.

## What is and is not established

Computationally checkable: source hashes/table schemas, namespace-safe joins, CRP availability, paired-slot parsing, temporal states, event-conditioned target, support gates, locked model outputs, calibration, bootstrap intervals and whether conclusions match those outputs.

Requires clinical adjudication or another study: actual encounter completeness, symptom onset, referral/screening, true cancer onset, stage, treatment, mechanism, causal effect, mortality/incidence and external validity. The follow-up field `20191-0.0` cannot establish any of these.

## Alternatives not chosen and revisit criteria

- Olink/proteomic augmentation: blocked until a documented `olink_dta)-to-`ukb672073) crosswalk is admitted; do not revisit merely because row counts look similar.
- Raw CRC PRS arm: revisit only after selected-column parseability, value distribution, participant overlap and every class/state/window support gate pass. Its result would test inherited susceptibility, not encounter completeness.
- Neural sequence model: revisit only if encounter-level dated histories or a validated observation process is admitted, or if B2 produces a reproducible temporal/biomarker pattern that a longer history can independently test.
- Mortality/incidence analysis: remains explicitly out of scope unless complete outcome and censoring provenance are admitted.

## Key works inspected

[K1] Mathew D et al., “Development and application of a frailty index derived from patient-reported outcome measures and comorbidities in oncology patients.” Internal Medicine Journal, 2026, DOI 10.1111/imj.70599. Abstract-only. It bounds post-diagnosis frailty-survival associations and does not establish prediagnostic timing or recordability.

[K2] Chen G et al., “Age-dependent cytokine surge in blood precedes cancer diagnosis.” PNAS, 2025, DOI 10.1073/pnas.2420502122. Abstract-only. It supports occult biological timing as a plausible rival, but is not CRC-specific and has no contact measure.

[K3] Lu SSM et al., “Prediagnostic Prescription Antibiotics Use and Survival in Patients with Colorectal Cancer: A Swedish National Register-Based Study.” Cancer Epidemiology, Biomarkers & Prevention, 2023, DOI 10.1158/1055-9965.epi-23-0340. Abstract-only. It demonstrates what stage/treatment/complete registers could add, none of which is bound here.

Receipts and exact UTF-8 inspected excerpts are attached separately. These references were reused unchanged from the parent; no inaccessible full text or supplementary method is claimed.

# UKB diagnosis-anchored CRC timing: full-cohort recorded-source selection audit

Status: proposed, not fitted. This is a substantive child of candidate-c4e6c5069a1aebfa629e3a2d. It repairs the parent’s descriptive selection check by making the full assessment cohort the denominator for an observable recorded-source audit, and by pre-specifying a second-source CRC concordance sensitivity. It does not claim encounter completeness, incidence, mortality, true disease onset, causality, or clinical benefit.

## 1. Scientific opening, evidence boundary and hypothesis

The parent’s strongest supported claim is narrow: among participants with a valid 2006–2010 assessment and a subsequently observed paired 41270/41280 diagnosis-history event, assessment-time reserve may be associated with the lag to the first recorded CRC relative to other recorded diagnoses. That is a conditional recorded-event association. It is not a population risk or an incidence estimate because a participant with no observed post-assessment event may have had no event, an event in an unobserved source, or insufficient observation.

The unresolved question is whether a reserve-by-recorded-CRC-lag contrast persists after directly characterizing the event-observation boundary in the full eligible assessment cohort. Two explanations remain observationally plausible:

1. **Occult timing/diagnostic proximity:** lower reserve is closer to an underlying CRC process, so the reserve contrast should be relatively CRC-specific, concentrated in the near-assessment window, and similar for CRC records that are concordant across the two available cancer-record streams.
2. **Observed-record selection:** reserve, age, comorbidity history and recent recorded history affect whether a diagnosis becomes visible in a particular source and when it is recorded. This predicts gradients in the full-cohort recorded-source categories, source-specific CRC capture, and the lag contrast’s dependence on source concordance. It can also generate a non-cancer recorded-history gradient.

[K1] supports reserve/frailty as a clinically meaningful construct in post-diagnosis oncology, but does not establish prediagnostic timing or UKB record capture. [K2] makes latent disease-related physiological change before diagnosis a plausible timing rival, but does not measure this UKB reserve or encounter observation. [K3] shows the additional evidence used in a consequential CRC register study—population-complete linkage, stage and cancer-specific outcomes—while those fields are unavailable here. None establishes a CRC-specific prediagnostic reserve-to-recorded-lag mechanism in this binding.

**Hypothesis.** Conditional on the same pre-assessment recorded-history state and available assessment covariates, a lower-reserve contrast in near-assessment lag will be larger for first recorded CRC than for first recorded non-cancer diagnosis, and this CRC excess will persist in the subset whose 41270/41280 CRC record has a paired 40005/40006 CRC record within 30 days. The hypothesis is jointly falsifiable: a reserve gradient in full-cohort source capture, a large change between all 41270/41280 CRC records and cross-source-concordant CRC records, or a similar reserve-by-near-lag gradient for non-cancer records supports observed-record selection or coding/timing artifacts rather than a CRC-specific interpretation.

A positive result would establish only a robust association among observed diagnosis-history transitions after these measured source checks. It would not establish occult disease, true onset, healthcare contact, mechanism, causality or a screening indication.

## 2. Exact data binding and read-only rules

The frozen source audit is source-schema-audit.json, attached with this proposal. Snapshot: ukb-completed-subset-20261002; catalog SHA-256: 6834d79f6da16d271bd2f4e017feff3648babeb8e3ea41122015757f0adedf32. Every join uses only eid in the ukb672073 namespace. Do not join UKB-671626, Olink, dta or any other identifier namespace. Source Parquets are read-only; derived tables and model outputs belong in the workspace.

| role | exact source path; SHA-256 | catalog table / archive member | required fields |
|---|---|---|---|
| assessment and reserve | [private-path]/ukb_d61ec821b81b9034.parquet; e69705f71f6a4f263371bec081d50a7d9482291d73cde09873634b327936a841 | UKB/ukb672073_Assessment_Center.csv (Parquet); table-6fc0a334db7f533b; ordinary Parquet, no archive member | eid, 53-0.0, 46-0.0, 47-0.0, 20116-0.0, 21001-0.0 |
| demographics | [private-path]/ukb_ce68812c3a782e09.parquet; d446c8288dfe59abc97e44a43027628aa7221a60f307d4da879a7c491b930299 | UKB/ukb672073_Population_Characteristics.csv (Parquet); table-674bd55f4152a860; ordinary Parquet, no archive member | eid, 31-0.0, 34-0.0, 21022-0.0 |
| laboratory reserve | [private-path]/ukb_a19465be8f90accc.parquet; 9a62c73361094f4e12045082d8872efa84933e7bb86f596e9e8a49fc162a4ab0 | UKB/ukb672073_Biological_Samples.csv (Parquet); table-50f94f98137a2d88; ordinary Parquet, no archive member | eid, 30600-0.0, 30700-0.0, 30720-0.0 |
| paired diagnosis/cancer records | [private-path]/ukb_e53f1b242ccf9047.parquet; 36d0e32efc608dd0e324a6e66fd4211813e7542ec08b78213488ab8f52874ad8 | UKB/ukb672073_Health_Related_Outcomes.csv (Parquet); table-03f57283ab9ae48b; ordinary Parquet, no archive member | eid; 40005-0.0–40005-21.0 paired with 40006-0.0–40006-21.0; 41270-0.0–41270-0.258 paired with 41280-0.0–41280-0.258 |
| follow-up provenance audit only | [private-path]/ukb_c9f8c514956c9481.parquet; 42c0e50e9b3e270bb578a4c56f0d753c9a794ad69e56a221bae940dd9060b1d5 | UKB/ukb672073_Online_Follow_up.csv (Parquet); table-99ff3ee72fc4030a; ordinary Parquet, no archive member | eid, 20191-0.0 only; audit and report, never use as censoring or completeness |

The schema audit recorded 502,370 assessment rows with non-null 53-0.0, parseable assessment dates from 2006-03-13 through 2010-10-01, and 167,852 parseable cells across the selected 40005 cancer-date array. These are source-audit facts, not analytic event counts. Selected fields were object/string in the audit; code must explicitly cast numeric values and parse dates.

A valid event is always a same-slot pair: 40005[j] with 40006[j], or 41270[j] with 41280[j]. Do not borrow a neighboring date, infer dates from array order, treat an unpaired code as an event, or treat either stream as a gold-standard complete ascertainment source.

## 3. Population and temporal boundaries

Let b_i be parsed 53-0.0. Retain 2006-01-01 ≤ b_i ≤ 2010-12-31, unique eid, valid sex, age, BMI, smoking and at least three of four reserve components. Define the **full eligible assessment population U** before looking at post-assessment events. Exclude a participant only if either paired source has an observed C00–C97 record on or before b_i. Call this “no observed pre-assessment cancer record”; never call it cancer-free.

For 41270/41280, pair slots j=0,…,258, normalize ICD-10 strings without inventing missing prefixes, and deduplicate exact code/date pairs. A pre-assessment non-cancer pair has a parseable date in [1900-01-01, b_i), with code outside C00–C97. Define the pre-assessment recorded-history state before any post-assessment scan:

- S=0: no valid non-cancer pair;
- S=1: at least one pair, but latest date is at or before b_i-730 days;
- S=2: latest date is within the preceding 730 days and there is exactly one unique non-cancer date in that interval;
- S=3: at least two unique non-cancer dates in that interval.

Retain raw unique-pair count, recent unique-date count and days since the latest recorded non-cancer pair as audit variables. S is not an encounter count or completeness score and cannot use post-b_i information.

The **primary diagnosis-history event subset E** is formed by scanning paired 41270/41280 records after b_i through b_i+1825 days. Let t_i be the earliest valid post-assessment date. Classify its first event as CRC (C18, C19 or C20), other cancer (C00–C97 excluding C18–C20), or non-cancer (all other valid codes). If distinct classes occur on the same earliest date, flag and exclude the tie from the primary fit; retain it in a fixed tie-inclusion sensitivity. Define L_i=t_i-b_i, near as 0<L_i<730 days, and late as 730≤L_i≤1825. This is a recorded first-event target conditional on being observed, not survival time and not incidence.

For source-capture characterization in the full U, scan paired 40005/40006 CRC records and paired 41270/41280 CRC records separately in the same (b_i,b_i+1825] window. Define an observed-source outcome O_i, only for describing records:

- O0: no CRC record observed in either selected source;
- O1: CRC observed in 41270/41280 only;
- O2: CRC observed in 40005/40006 only;
- O3: CRC observed in both, with first-source dates within 30 days;
- O4: CRC observed in both, but first-source dates differ by more than 30 days.

O0 is not “no CRC.” It combines no disease, unobserved disease and unavailable records. O1–O4 are relative source-capture categories, not sensitivity estimates. Report the first dates, date difference, code-family agreement and exact-date as well as ±30-day concordance. Do not use a 40005 record to manufacture a non-cancer event or a 41270 record to manufacture a 40005 date.

For the CRC rows of E, attach M_i=O1, O3, or O4 as applicable; a CRC observed only in 40005/40006 is not in E. The source-concordant sensitivity is M=O3, and the source-discordant/41270-only sensitivity retains O1 and O4 separately where support permits.

## 4. Reserve, covariates, estimands and selection mitigation

Construct reserve exactly as inherited: grip_max=max(46-0.0,47-0.0), albumin 30600-0.0, creatinine 30700-0.0, and cystatin C 30720-0.0. Fit transformations only on training data: sex-stratified grip standardization, log albumin, negative-log creatinine and negative-log cystatin C. Let R be the mean of available standardized components. Retain component count and missingness. Covariates are age 21022-0.0, sex 31-0.0, BMI 21001-0.0, smoking 20116-0.0, assessment year and 34-0.0 as a calendar audit. The inherited scalar-history comparator H_cat is 0, 1, 2–4 or ≥5 unique pre-assessment non-cancer code/date pairs.

The primary lag contrast for event class g, history state s, and CRC capture stratum m is

A_{g,s,m} =
P(L<730 | G=g,S=s,M=m,R=Q25)
− P(L<730 | G=g,S=s,M=m,R=Q75).

For non-cancer M is not defined, so use all eligible non-cancer 41270/41280 first events with the same state and covariate standardization. Define

D_all = sum_{s,x} w_{s,x}(A_CRC,s,all − A_NC,s),
D_conc = sum_{s,x} w_{s,x}(A_CRC,s,O3 − A_NC,s),

where w_{s,x} is locked to the full eligible U distribution over supported history state and available baseline covariates x, with overlap restrictions fixed before fitting. These are standardized conditional recorded-event contrasts. The selection-sensitivity quantity is Δ_source=D_conc−D_all, reported with participant-bootstrap intervals. A small, directionally stable Δ_source does not prove complete ascertainment; a large shift or reversal is evidence that the recorded-event selection boundary materially affects the scientific comparison.

Separately estimate, in the full U, the observed-source probabilities P(O=o | R,S,x) for o=O0,…,O4, and report reserve-quartile contrasts for O1, O2, O3, and O4 versus the locked full-cohort standardization. This is the direct audit that the parent lacked. No inverse-probability weight may treat O0 as a disease-negative outcome or repair missing-not-at-random ascertainment. A descriptive full-cohort standardization may reduce measured composition differences; it cannot recover undocumented encounters.

## 5. Baseline and substantive alternative on the same inputs

The actual deliverable is newly computed evidence: full-U source-category flow and support; source-specific CRC dates and code agreement; P(O|R,S,x) and reserve/capture contrasts; D_all, D_conc, Δ_source, state-specific contrasts and 95% intervals; held-out predictive/calibration outputs; and a conclusion explicitly tied to those outputs. No fitted result is asserted here.

Assign one deterministic participant split before event construction using a hash of eid, seed 36: 70% train, 15% validation and 15% locked test. All rows for one eid remain in one split. Fit imputation, scaling, reserve quartiles, standardization weights and tuning only on training data. Do not inspect locked outcomes for model choice.

Use the same full-U rows, same eid split and same engineered input vector X for the recorded-source target O:

- reserve components and R, component count and missingness;
- age, sex, BMI, smoking, assessment year and 34-0.0;
- S, days since latest pre-assessment non-cancer pair, recent unique-date count and H_cat.

Use the same X, same split and same participants for the event-conditioned Y=(G,near/late) target in E, with M included only as a prespecified post-selection source-stratum descriptor, never as an exposure for the primary all-event contrast.

**B0, interpretable additive baseline.** Fit multinomial logistic regression for O in full U, and a separate multinomial logistic regression for Y in E, with additive terms, age spline, prespecified reserve-by-S interaction, and no data-driven interaction search. Fit the legacy scalar-history R+H_cat version as a nested ablation. Report standardized source probabilities and D_all/D_conc from locked predictions, not in-sample fits.

**B1, substantive learned alternative.** Fit a shallow gradient-boosted multinomial model to the identical X, rows, targets and split. Use only a fixed validation-selected grid of 200/400 trees, depth 2/3 and learning rate .03/.05. Its scientific purpose is to reveal reproducible nonlinear reserve thresholds or reserve-by-history-by-source interactions that the additive baseline can miss, not to reward a small predictive gain. Examine held-out partial-dependence/effect tables for O1–O4 and for CRC versus non-cancer near-lag contrasts. Treat a learned pattern as substantively informative only if it changes P(O|R,S,x), D_all, D_conc or Δ_source, is calibrated on the locked test, and survives the fixed source/date sensitivities. GPU is unnecessary for these tabular fits; the alternative is retained because its nonlinear source-interaction information could reveal selection that B0 compresses.

Report locked-test multiclass Brier score and log loss, calibration by O category and Y category, one-vs-rest AUC descriptively, all standardized contrasts, and at least 500 participant-bootstrap resamples with the split preserved. Predictive improvement alone cannot establish mechanism or clinical utility.

## 6. Readiness gates and falsification

Before any fit, write a machine-readable audit containing:

1. exact source paths, hashes, table IDs, ordinary-file/archive-member status, namespace and selected columns;
2. paired-slot parseability, malformed code/date, duplicates, pre-assessment cancer exclusions, first-event ties and cross-source date/code conflicts;
3. full-U counts for O0–O4, including reserve/history support and the number of exact/±30-day concordant pairs;
4. G×S× near/late support for 41270/41280, CRC capture-stratum support, reserve availability and missingness;
5. overlap of every baseline/alternative train, validation and locked cell;
6. confirmation that 20191-0.0 was not used as a censoring boundary, denominator or completeness proxy.

The primary lag analysis requires at least 30 participants in every required CRC and non-cancer G×S× near/late cell and nonempty cells in every split. The source-concordant sensitivity requires at least 30 CRC observations in each required near/late cell for O3; the O1 and O4 strata must each have at least 30 total CRC observations before their contrasts are interpreted. Do not merge deficient states or source strata after seeing results. If support fails, report the corresponding selection audit or concordance sensitivity as inconclusive. A single predeclared fallback may combine S=2 and S=3 as “recent” only if all required cells pass the same gate.

Fixed falsification and boundary checks:

- **Full-cohort capture gradient:** a reserve or history gradient in O1/O2/O3/O4 after covariate and state standardization is adverse to treating the event-conditioned lag association as biological; it is evidence of differential recorded-source visibility, not proof of an encounter mechanism.
- **Concordance stability:** compare exact-date, ±30-day and code-family concordance. Material movement of D_conc or Δ_source indicates source/date instability.
- **Selection shift:** compare D_all with D_conc, O1 and O4 where supported. Large attenuation or reversal after restricting to cross-source-concordant CRC is adverse to a robust CRC-specific interpretation.
- **Generic recorded-history control:** compare CRC, other cancer and non-cancer contrasts within S. Similar reserve-by-near-lag gradients across classes support generic recordability.
- **Temporal boundary:** repeat near cutoffs at 365 and 730 days and late cutoff at 1460 days. A shortest-window-only effect is a timing boundary, not durable reserve evidence.
- **Measurement and confounding:** complete-four versus minimum-three reserve, grip-only, laboratory-only, age-only and age-plus-H_cat fits. Attenuation identifies dependence on measured confounding, missingness or reserve construction; it does not identify a mechanism.
- **Coding/source permutation:** perform one locked within-state permutation of the event-class label and one fixed source-label permutation among eligible paired CRC records. Any reproducible reserve contrast under the relevant permutation invalidates that computation.
- **No false negative control:** O0 must never be called disease-free, and absence from 40005/40006 must never be used as proof that a 41270/41280 event was not real.

**Supportive outcome.** All gates pass; full-U source-category probabilities show no material reserve/history gradient in relative CRC source capture; D_all and D_conc are directionally stable with a positive CRC-minus-non-cancer contrast, a near-window concentration, no comparable other-cancer/non-cancer pattern, stable exact/±30-day concordance, calibrated held-out predictions and no permutation signal. This supports a robust association among observed transitions after the available source audit, not an occult-disease or causal conclusion.

**Adverse outcome.** Source capture varies with reserve/history, D_conc attenuates or reverses relative to D_all, non-cancer has a comparable gradient, date/code concordance is unstable, one component or missingness rule drives the pattern, or permutation produces a signal. Narrow the claim to recorded-source selection/timing or abandon the CRC-specific reserve interpretation.

## 1. Scientific opening and claim boundary

The seed asks whether low ApoB accompanied by low albumin and abnormal liver enzymes signals clinically important occult liver disease and a near-term liver-cancer warning pattern. The strongest support available before this experiment is indirect:

- [K1] inspected full text reports UKB MRI-PDFF, liver disease diagnoses and proteomics, and says routine liver enzymes are nonspecific and poor predictors of progression. It supports a liver-metabolism/progression rationale, not this ApoB/albumin/ALT/CRP combination.
- [K2] inspected abstract-only evidence reports a large prospective UKB study with linked incident HCC, MRI-PDFF, fibroinflammation and proteomics. - [K3] inspected abstract-only evidence reports prospective UKB protein signals for cirrhosis with external validation. It supports prediagnostic circulating-signal plausibility, not liver-cancer prediction or a mechanism for low ApoB.

Thus the supported claim is only that lipid, synthetic-function, enzyme and inflammatory measurements are biologically plausible correlates of liver disease, and that recorded liver outcomes can be studied prospectively in principle. The unresolved claim is:

> Among participants with an eligible UKB assessment and no observed paired C22 record before that assessment, does the pre-specified combination of low ApoB, low albumin and high ALT predict a larger near-assessment probability of a subsequently recorded C22* liver/intrahepatic-bile-duct cancer than low ApoB alone, after measured CRP and medication-proxy adjustment, and is the contrast stable across the two available diagnosis-record streams?

A positive result would justify expert review and external validation of a warning-pattern hypothesis; it would not justify screening or treatment.

2. Medication and care/recording selection: medication use, recent recorded diagnoses and healthcare contact affect both biomarker levels and the probability/timing/source of a recorded diagnosis. This predicts gradients in O0-O4 source categories, large changes when restricting to cross-source-concordant C22 records, or dependence on the 20003 proxy.
3. Measurement/timing artifact: instance 0 biomarkers may not be contemporaneous or repeated values may be selected. This predicts instability under same-slot instance-1 sensitivity, component-complete versus minimum-component rules, or exact versus +/-30-day source concordance.

These comparisons separate predictive/descriptive regularity from causal or mechanistic claims. Even a stable adjusted association cannot prove that occult cancer caused the biomarker pattern.

- L2, the primary warning pattern: ApoB <= Q25, albumin <= Q25 and ALT >= Q75.

Use a deterministic eid hash split with seed 39: 70% train, 15% validation and 15% locked test; all rows for one eid stay in one split. Imputation, scaling, quartiles, pattern thresholds, standardization weights and hyperparameter choices are training/validation operations only. B0 and B1 use identical rows, feature vector, targets and split.

B0 is an interpretable additive model: logistic regression for Y_C22,near in full U; multinomial logistic regression for O0-O4 in full U; and a discrete-time near/late multinomial model for observed first events. Inputs are ApoB, albumin, ALT, log1p(CRP), L1/L2 indicators, medication count/availability, age, sex, calendar year, BMI/smoking when bound, missingness, and pre-assessment history. Include only the pre-specified pattern-by-window and pattern-by-medication interactions. Report locked-test standardized RD_near, RD_conc, Delta_source, calibration, Brier/log loss and participant-bootstrap intervals.

B1 is a shallow gradient-boosted tree model on the identical feature vector, rows, labels and split, with a locked validation grid of 200/400 trees, depth 2/3 and learning rate .03/.05. Its scientific purpose is to expose nonlinear thresholds and L2-by-CRP-by-medication selection structure that an additive model compresses. A learned effect is substantive only if it changes the standardized contrasts or O-category probabilities, is calibrated on the locked test, and persists under exact versus +/-30-day concordance and C22.0 sensitivity. Before fitting, emit a machine-readable audit with source paths/hashes/table IDs, namespace, column presence, paired parseability, malformed code/date counts, duplicates, pre-assessment exclusions, O0-O4 counts, exact/+/-30-day concordance, exposure support, source overlap, repeated-slot availability and train/validation/test overlap. Confirm that 20191-0.0 and O0 were not used as censoring/completeness proxies.

The primary C22 contrast is interpretable only if there are at least 30 recorded C22 events in each of L1 and L2, at least 10 in each split for both exposure groups, and nonempty supported cells for near and late. The O3 sensitivity additionally requires at least 30 O3 C22 participants overall and at least 10 per exposure group; O1 and O4 are reported only if each has at least 30 total C22 participants. Supportive result: all gates pass; L2 has a positive RD_near over L1; the contrast is larger for C22 than non-cancer/other cancer, concentrated in near rather than late records, remains directionally stable in RD_conc and exact/+/-30-day sensitivity, does not materially attenuate after CRP/medication/history adjustment, and has calibrated held-out predictions with no permutation signal. Adverse result: a similar L2 contrast appears for non-cancer or other cancer; O1/O2/O3/O4 varies materially by exposure or history; RD_conc attenuates/reverses RD_all; exact/+/-30-day concordance is unstable; medication/CRP adjustment removes the contrast; the signal is driven by missingness or one biomarker; or a locked label/source permutation reproduces it. ## 4. Population and temporal boundaries

Cast strings explicitly, parse dates, normalize ICD-10 code strings without inventing missing prefixes, and deduplicate exact code/date pairs.
