## 5. Exposure, recorded-history audit and estimand

Fit all quartile cut-points on the training portion only. Define:

- L0, the reference, as ApoB above the training Q25 or not meeting the low-ApoB-only/pattern definitions.
- L1, low ApoB alone: ApoB <= training Q25, with albumin > Q25 or ALT < Q75.
- L2, the primary warning pattern: ApoB <= Q25, albumin <= Q25 and ALT >= Q75.
- CRP is not hidden inside the primary exposure. Retain log1p(CRP), its Q75 indicator and missingness as an explicit inflammation rival/modifier. A fixed secondary asks whether L2 is stronger when CRP >= Q75.
- Medication proxy is the count of nonmissing codes across 20003-0.0…20003-0.47 and an any-entry indicator. This is not complete treatment, adherence or statin exposure; code-family interpretation requires a separately verified dictionary and is not assumed.

Before scanning post-assessment records, derive a pre-assessment 41270/41280 recorded-history summary from valid non-C22 pairs dated before b_i: number of unique pairs, number of unique recent dates in the preceding 730 days, and days since the latest pair. This is a recordability proxy, not encounter completeness. It may not use post-b_i information.

In the full U, classify observed C22 source capture over (b_i,b_i+1825] as O0 no C22 in either source, O1 C22 in 41270/41280 only, O2 C22 in 40005/40006 only, O3 in both with first dates within 30 days, and O4 in both with first dates differing by >30 days. Also report exact-date concordance, +/-30-day concordance, code-family agreement and date differences. O0 combines no recorded disease with unobserved disease and must never be used as a disease-negative label.

The primary estimand is the standardized recorded-event risk difference:
RD_near = P(Y_C22,near=1 | L2) - P(Y_C22,near=1 | L1),
where probabilities are standardized to the locked full-U distribution of age, sex, calendar year, medication-proxy availability, CRP and pre-assessment recorded-history state under the chosen overlap rule. Report RD_near and a ratio only if support permits. The primary source is paired 41270/41280 because it has the larger diagnosis array; 40005/40006 supplies an independent recorded-cancer stream. Report RD_all for all valid 41270/41280 C22 events and RD_conc restricted to O3. The source sensitivity is Delta_source=RD_conc-RD_all. Also report the same contrasts for other cancer and non-cancer first recorded events, and the near-versus-late contrast.

A secondary conditional timing estimand among participants with an observed 41270/41280 first event is the L2-versus-L1 difference in P(near | first event class, recorded-history state), for C22 and for non-cancer. This is explicitly conditional on a recorded event and cannot be called time-to-cancer or survival.

## 6. Baseline and substantive alternative

Use a deterministic eid hash split with seed 39: 70% train, 15% validation and 15% locked test; all rows for one eid stay in one split. Imputation, scaling, quartiles, pattern thresholds, standardization weights and hyperparameter choices are training/validation operations only. B0 and B1 use identical rows, feature vector, targets and split.

B0 is an interpretable additive model: logistic regression for Y_C22,near in full U; multinomial logistic regression for O0-O4 in full U; and a discrete-time near/late multinomial model for observed first events. Inputs are ApoB, albumin, ALT, log1p(CRP), L1/L2 indicators, medication count/availability, age, sex, calendar year, BMI/smoking when bound, missingness, and pre-assessment history. Include only the pre-specified pattern-by-window and pattern-by-medication interactions. Report locked-test standardized RD_near, RD_conc, Delta_source, calibration, Brier/log loss and participant-bootstrap intervals.

B1 is a shallow gradient-boosted tree model on the identical feature vector, rows, labels and split, with a locked validation grid of 200/400 trees, depth 2/3 and learning rate .03/.05. Its scientific purpose is to expose nonlinear thresholds and L2-by-CRP-by-medication selection structure that an additive model compresses. A learned effect is substantive only if it changes the standardized contrasts or O-category probabilities, is calibrated on the locked test, and persists under exact versus +/-30-day concordance and C22.0 sensitivity. A small predictive improvement alone is not a scientific advance.

Repeated-measurement sensitivity uses only participants with parseable 53-1.0 and same-slot biomarker instance-1 values (30640-1.0, 30600-1.0, 30620-1.0, 30710-1.0). Compare instance-0 and instance-1 pattern contrasts and, where supported, biomarker direction/change. Because no biomarker-specific timestamp is present, this is a same-slot sensitivity, not a validated longitudinal trajectory.

The exact method comparison and resource reasoning are recorded in method-alternatives.md. This is CPU tabular work: plan 4–8 CPUs and 16–32 GiB; the fixed fits are estimated at 1–3 hours and 500+ participant bootstrap at 2–6 hours, estimates not measured. GPU use is not required; a transformer/GP model is deferred because dated repeated biomarker trajectories and mechanistic modalities are unavailable.

## 7. Readiness and support gates

Before fitting, emit a machine-readable audit with source paths/hashes/table IDs, namespace, column presence, paired parseability, malformed code/date counts, duplicates, pre-assessment exclusions, O0-O4 counts, exact/+/-30-day concordance, exposure support, source overlap, repeated-slot availability and train/validation/test overlap. Confirm that 20191-0.0 and O0 were not used as censoring/completeness proxies.

The primary C22 contrast is interpretable only if there are at least 30 recorded C22 events in each of L1 and L2, at least 10 in each split for both exposure groups, and nonempty supported cells for near and late. The O3 sensitivity additionally requires at least 30 O3 C22 participants overall and at least 10 per exposure group; O1 and O4 are reported only if each has at least 30 total C22 participants. No deficient group may be merged after seeing results. A single predeclared fallback may combine C22 near/late only for a descriptive all-window audit, not for the primary near estimand.

If the gate fails, report the full-cohort source audit and supported descriptive counts but label RD_near/C22 timing inconclusive. Do not replace the C22 outcome with all cancer, use O0 as a negative control, or declare the hypothesis refuted by sparse events.

## 8. Falsification and interpretation

Supportive result: all gates pass; L2 has a positive RD_near over L1; the contrast is larger for C22 than non-cancer/other cancer, concentrated in near rather than late records, remains directionally stable in RD_conc and exact/+/-30-day sensitivity, does not materially attenuate after CRP/medication/history adjustment, and has calibrated held-out predictions with no permutation signal. This supports a reproducible association among observed records. It does not establish occult cancer, onset, mechanism, causality or a screening threshold.

Adverse result: a similar L2 contrast appears for non-cancer or other cancer; O1/O2/O3/O4 varies materially by exposure or history; RD_conc attenuates/reverses RD_all; exact/+/-30-day concordance is unstable; medication/CRP adjustment removes the contrast; the signal is driven by missingness or one biomarker; or a locked label/source permutation reproduces it. Interpret the pattern as likely recordability, nutrition/inflammation/medication confounding or measurement artifact, and abandon the liver-cancer-specific warning interpretation.

Inconclusive result: C22/O3 support fails, intervals remain wide, repeated-slot overlap is inadequate, calibration/bootstrap fails, or the source audit reveals unresolved date/code ambiguity. Preserve the audit and seek expert review, validated treatment/established-liver-disease history, clinical adjudication, MRI-PDFF/biopsy or an external cohort before stronger claims. A null with wide uncertainty does not refute the pattern.

Use fixed falsification checks: 365-day and 730-day near cutoffs; 1,460-day late cutoff; minimum-three versus complete-four biomarkers; instance-1 same-slot sensitivity; C22.0-only coding; 40005/40006 versus 41270/41280 source comparisons; within-state C22 versus other-cancer/non-cancer comparisons; one locked source-label permutation and one within-state event-class permutation. Permutation signals invalidate the relevant computation.

## 9. Missing evidence and clinical adjudication

MRI-PDFF 21088 appears in the assessment schema but its nonmissing overlap, acquisition date alignment and usable payload were not verified, so it is not used. Complete treatment exposure, statin indication/adherence, established liver disease/cirrhosis/fibrosis stage, viral hepatitis status, alcohol exposure sufficient for adjudication, nutritional intake, imaging, pathology, tumor stage and true symptom/onset dates are unavailable or unverified. 20003 is only a medication-entry proxy. Paired records are not a gold-standard ascertainment system, and online follow-up 20191 is not a completeness boundary.

Computation can check exact binding, pair construction, cohort flow, recorded source categories, standardized contrasts, model predictions, calibration, bootstrap uncertainty, sensitivity outputs and whether conclusions follow from them. It cannot establish clinical diagnosis, occult disease, mechanism, causality, treatment benefit, true incidence, or transportability. Those require clinical adjudication, additional data or another externally validated study.

## 10. Three inspected key works

Exactly three distinct works are attached through key-references.json and the three UTF-8 evidence snapshots:

[K1] Sveinbjornsson G et al. Multiomics study of nonalcoholic fatty liver disease. Nature Genetics. 2022. DOI 10.1038/s41588-022-01199-5. Full-text passages inspected; MRI-PDFF/proteomics and enzyme limitations bound the adaptation.

[K2] Kim HS et al. Coffee Consumption and Improved Liver Outcomes: Clinical, Imaging, and Proteomic Evidence From the UK Biobank. Clinical Gastroenterology and Hepatology. 2026. DOI 10.1016/j.cgh.2026.04.035. Abstract-only inspection; its linked HCC/MRI/proteomics evidence is not claimed as available here.

[K3] He J et al. Identification of Pre-Diagnostic Protein Biomarkers for Liver Cirrhosis Based on Prospective Analysis of a Large-Scale Plasma Proteomics in the UK Biobank. Proteomics Clinical Applications. 2026. DOI 10.1002/prca.70050. Abstract-only inspection; cirrhosis prediction is not substituted for C22 evidence.

Supporting files: source-schema-audit.json, method-alternatives.md, key-references.json, evidence-K1-sveinbjornsson-fulltext.txt, evidence-K2-kim-coffee-abstract.txt, evidence-K3-he-cirrhosis-abstract.txt. No fitted results are asserted.


## Branch-specific evolution note (lead repair, revision 85)

This branch preserves the seed question but makes the decisive comparison an observed-record timing contrast, not an occult-disease claim. The primary warning pattern is low ApoB plus low albumin plus high ALT (training-derived Q25/Q75 cut-points), with CRP retained as an explicit inflammation rival rather than hidden inside the exposure. The key falsification is whether the pattern is C22-specific and near-assessment, remains directionally stable in paired 41270/41280 records that also have 40005/40006 support, and does not disappear after age, pre-assessment recorded-history, medication-entry, and source-category audits. A similar pattern for non-cancer/other-cancer records, source-category gradients, or large all-record versus concordant-record movement is adverse to the preclinical interpretation.

The substantive method choice is deliberately bounded: additive logistic/multinomial models provide transparent pattern contrasts and source probabilities; shallow gradient boosting is retained only to reveal thresholds or pattern-by-CRP-by-medication interactions that add scientific information. MRI-PDFF, complete treatment exposure, fibrosis/cirrhosis stage, viral/alcohol/nutrition adjudication, pathology, stage and true onset remain missing or unverified. No fitted results are claimed.

# Crossover: source-concordant cancer specificity of reserve-to-recorded-event timing

Status: proposed design, not fitted. Independent crossover of candidate-f0914c11c50cfe66051d2bda (CRC source-capture audit) and candidate-15f22122fb63166d354fe6b2 (C22 biomarker/timing rival). The deliverable is newly fitted held-out class contrasts and source-audit outputs; no discovery fit or result is claimed.

## 1. Scientific opening and hypothesis

The strongest supported inherited claim is conditional and observational: among people with a valid 2006–2010 assessment and a subsequently observed paired 41270/41280 diagnosis-history event, assessment-time reserve may correlate with whether the first recorded event is near the assessment, with a possible CRC excess. The C22 branch adds a low-ApoB/low-albumin/high-ALT pattern, but that pattern could be systemic nutrition/inflammation/liver reserve or record visibility rather than liver-cancer biology. Neither branch establishes cancer-free status, incidence, onset, encounter completeness, mechanism, causality, stage, treatment, mortality or clinical benefit.

The unresolved question is whether the apparent prediagnostic reserve-to-recorded-cancer timing association is cancer-specific—especially C22 versus CRC/other cancer—or is explained by measured inflammation/nutrition/liver state and differential visibility in the two recorded sources. This matters because a genuinely C22-specific, source-concordant signal would justify an expert-designed liver-specific validation study; a signal that is common across cancer classes or moves with source visibility should not be interpreted as an organ-specific warning pattern.

The leading explanation is a class-specific biological timing signal: lower reserve or a low-ApoB/low-albumin/high-ALT pattern is closer to a latent C22 process, so its near-event contrast should exceed CRC and other-cancer contrasts and remain directionally stable for paired 40005/40006 and 41270/41280 records. The strongest measured rival is systemic reserve/nutrition/inflammation or liver injury: albumin, CRP, ALT, BMI and medication-entry availability track general illness and healthcare visibility, producing similar near-recording gradients across C22, CRC, other cancer and non-cancer. A second rival is source/coding selection: the apparent contrast is concentrated in 41270-only or date-discordant records and attenuates in cross-source-concordant records. The data cannot separate biology from true onset or healthcare contact, but these rivals make different predictions about class gradients, covariate attenuation and source stability.

**Hypothesis.** After standardization to the same pre-assessment recorded-history state and measured assessment covariates, the lower-reserve Q25-versus-Q75 near-lag contrast is larger for first recorded C22 than for first recorded CRC and other cancer, and the C22 excess persists among records with paired-source first dates within 30 days. A secondary liver-pattern test asks whether low ApoB plus low albumin plus high ALT (L2) has a larger C22 near-recorded-event contrast than low ApoB alone (L1), and whether that difference survives CRP, BMI, medication-entry and history-state adjustment. The hypothesis is falsified or narrowed if class contrasts are similar, if C22 loses its excess after measured adjustment, if the contrast changes materially by source concordance, or if a fixed class/source permutation reproduces it.

A supportive result establishes only a reproducible association among observed transitions under measured source checks. It does not establish occult cancer, true onset, a screening threshold or a mechanism.

## 2. Exact source binding

No UKB-671626, Olink, dta or other namespace is joined.

## 3. Population and time

Let b_i be parsed `53-0.0). Define the full eligible assessment population U before scanning post-assessment outcomes: one row per `eid`, b_i in [2006-01-01, 2010-12-31], valid age `21022-0.0`, sex `31-0.0`, BMI `21001-0.0`, smoking `20116-0.0`, and at least 3 of 4 reserve components (grip_max=max of `46-0.0`, `47-0.0`; albumin `30600-0.0`; creatinine `30700-0.0`; cystatin C `30720-0.0`). Primary liver-pattern analyses additionally require nonmissing ApoB, albumin and ALT; CRP is retained with a missingness indicator. The full-U source audit retains participants with biomarker missingness and reports its support rather than silently restricting it.

Exclude only a valid same-slot C00-C97 pair dated on or before b_i in either cancer/diagnosis stream. Label this “no observed pre-assessment cancer record,” never cancer-free. For every diagnosis event, require the code and date in the same array slot, parse dates, normalize ICD-10 strings without inventing prefixes, and deduplicate exact code/date pairs. A same-day tie between event classes is flagged and excluded from the primary first-event fit, then included in one fixed sensitivity.

Scan paired 41270/41280 records in (b_i, b_i+1825 days]. The first valid event class G is C22 (prefix C22), CRC (C18, C19 or C20), other cancer (C00-C97 excluding C22 and C18-C20), or non-cancer. Define near as 0 < L_i < 730 days and late as 730 <= L_i <= 1825 days, where L_i=t_i-b_i. This is a recorded first-event target conditional on an observed pair, not survival, incidence or true onset.

For each class c in {C22, CRC}, perform a separate two-source audit over the same window: O0 no class-c record in either source; O1 class-c only in 41270/41280; O2 class-c only in 40005/40006; O3 in both with first dates within 30 days; O4 in both with first dates differing by >30 days. Report exact-date, +/-30-day and code-family concordance and first-date differences. O0 is a mixed “not observed” category and is never disease-free. The 40005/40006 stream may not manufacture a 41270/41280 first event, and vice versa. Other-cancer source strata are reported only if the predeclared support gate passes.

Pre-assessment record visibility is summarized from valid paired 41270/41280 non-cancer pairs dated before b_i: S0 none; S1 latest at or before b_i-730 days; S2 one unique date in the prior 730 days; S3 at least two unique dates in the prior 730 days. Retain unique-pair count, recent-date count and days since latest pair. S is a recorded-history descriptor, not an encounter count or completeness score and may not use post-b_i information.

## 4. Exposures, covariates and estimands

The reserve score R is the mean of available training-standardized components: sex-stratified grip_max, log albumin, negative-log creatinine and negative-log cystatin C; retain component count and missingness. The primary reserve contrast is Q25 versus Q75 of R, with quartiles fixed on training data. The liver-specific rival uses the same training thresholds: L2 = ApoB <= Q25, albumin <= Q25 and ALT >= Q75; L1 = ApoB <= Q25 but not L2. CRP (log1p, Q75 indicator and missingness), BMI and medication-entry count are adjustment/modifier variables, not hidden parts of L2. The medication proxy is the count and any-entry indicator over `20003-0.0`...`20003-0.47`; it is not a coded drug exposure, treatment, adherence or statin indication. Albumin and BMI are measured nutrition/physiologic proxies, not dietary intake.

Let A_{g,m}^{R} be the standardized difference P(near | first recorded event class g, source stratum m, R=Q25) - P(near | g,m,R=Q75), standardized to the full-U distribution of age, sex, calendar year, S, BMI, CRP, medication-entry variables and supported overlap. Estimate g in {C22, CRC, other cancer, non-cancer}; m=all 41270/41280 events for the primary class comparison and m=O3 for the source-concordant sensitivity. The primary specificity estimand is I_R = A_C22,O3 - 0.5(A_CRC,O3 + A_other,O3), with I_R^{all} using all recorded events. Report C22-vs-CRC and C22-vs-other components separately; do not interpret I_R if a required cell fails support. The source-selection shift is Delta_source = I_R - I_R^{all}. If other-cancer O3 is unsupported, the prespecified primary becomes C22-vs-CRC O3 and the other-cancer contrast is labelled inconclusive, not merged.

The secondary biomarker estimand is I_L = B_C22,O3 - B_CRC,O3, where B_g,m is the standardized L2-versus-L1 difference in P(near | g,m), with the same covariate standardization and a corresponding all-source estimate. Report L2-vs-L1 for other cancer and non-cancer as controls. Results are participant-bootstrap 95% intervals; no inverse-probability weight treats O0 as a negative outcome or repairs missing-not-at-random ascertainment.

## 5. Baseline and substantive learned alternative

The actual scientific deliverable is newly computed, held-out evidence: the U flow and O0-O4 counts for C22 and CRC; paired date/code audit; G-by-S-by-near/late support; R and L1/L2 distributions and missingness; I_R, Delta_source and I_L with 95% participant-bootstrap intervals; sensitivity estimates; calibration and held-out predictions; and a conclusion that cites those outputs. No fitted results are asserted here.

Use a deterministic eid hash split with seed 61: 70% train, 15% validation and 15% locked test, assigned before outcome summaries; all rows of an eid stay together. Imputation, scaling, quartiles, pattern thresholds, standardization weights, model tuning and any supported-overlap restriction are fit on train/validation only. Locked outcomes are not used for decisions.

Both methods use identical U and E rows, feature vector X and split. X contains R components/R, component count/missingness, ApoB, albumin, ALT, CRP and missingness, BMI, age, sex, smoking, assessment year, medication count/any-entry and S plus its raw history summaries. Source stratum m is an evaluation label, never a primary exposure.

**B0 additive baseline.** Fit a multinomial logistic model for first-event target (G x near/late) in E and separate multinomial logistic models for O0-O4 for C22 and CRC in U. Include age spline, additive reserve and L2/L1 terms, and only prespecified reserve-by-S and L2-by-CRP/medication interactions. The legacy scalar history count is a nested ablation. Compute I_R, I_L and source probabilities from locked predictions standardized to U; report Brier score, log loss, calibration and descriptive one-vs-rest AUC.

**B1 substantive nonlinear alternative.** Fit shallow gradient-boosted multinomial models to exactly the same X, rows, targets and split, with a predeclared validation grid of 200/400 trees, depth 2/3 and learning rate .03/.05. Use effect tables to test whether thresholded ApoB-albumin-ALT structure, reserve-by-S interactions or CRP/medication subgroups change class-specific source probabilities or I_R/I_L. B1 is scientifically retained because B0 can average away a threshold or three-way selection interaction; a small predictive gain alone is not evidence. A learned pattern counts only if it changes a prespecified estimand, is calibrated on the locked test and remains directionally consistent under exact versus +/-30-day concordance, C22.0 and CRC-code-family sensitivities.

Plan 4-8 CPU cores, 16-32 GiB RAM, and <=2.5 hours for the columnar scan and fixed fits plus a separate bounded bootstrap job; these are estimates, not measured results. The solver planning envelope is 16 CPUs, 262,144 MiB and 28,800 seconds, while this discovery design does not launch solver fitting. GPU is not required for these tabular models. A sequence transformer is deferred because biomarkers have no verified biomarker-specific timestamps; a mechanistic causal model is deferred because MRI-PDFF payload/date alignment, pathology, fibrosis stage, complete treatment, symptoms and adjudicated onset are unavailable.

## 6. Readiness gates and falsification

Before fitting, write an audit with exact paths/hashes/table IDs/archive status/namespace/columns; same-slot parseability and malformed code/date counts; duplicates and pre-assessment exclusions; O0-O4 counts, exact and +/-30-day concordance; G x S x near/late support; exposure and split overlap; and confirmation that `20191-0.0) was not used for censoring, completeness or a denominator.

Require at least 30 participants in every primary C22, CRC, other-cancer and non-cancer near/late x S cell used for I_R, at least 30 O3 participants for each C22 and CRC class, at least 30 total other-cancer O3 participants before interpreting that component, and at least 10 participants per exposure group in each split. Do not merge deficient strata after inspecting results. A single predeclared fallback may combine S2 and S3 as “recent” only if every resulting required cell passes the same gate. If a gate fails, preserve the source audit and report the affected estimand inconclusive.

Falsification and boundary checks are fixed: (1) compare C22, CRC, other-cancer and non-cancer gradients; a common gradient supports generic reserve/recordability; (2) compare all-source with O3 and O1/O4; material attenuation or reversal makes the biological interpretation adverse; (3) compare exact versus +/-30-day and code-family concordance; movement indicates date/coding instability; (4) compare complete-four versus minimum-three reserve, grip-only, laboratory-only and age/history-only models; attenuation identifies dependence on measured construction, not a mechanism; (5) repeat near cutoff at 365 days and late cutoff at 1460 days; (6) test L2-vs-L1 with and without CRP, BMI, medication proxy and S; (7) use instance-1 same-slot biomarker values only as a labelled sensitivity because no biomarker-specific timestamp exists; (8) one locked within-S event-class permutation and one locked source-label permutation must not reproduce the contrast; (9) never call O0 disease-free or use absent 40005/40006 records as evidence that a 41270/41280 event did not occur.

**Supportive:** all gates pass; C22 exceeds CRC/other cancer in I_R and L2-vs-L1, the excess is near-window concentrated, directionally stable from all-source to O3 and exact/+/-30-day checks, not removed by CRP/nutrition/medication/history adjustment, with calibrated held-out predictions and null permutations. This supports an observed-record association worth organ-specific validation, not occult C22, onset or causality.

**Adverse:** similar class gradients, a reserve/history gradient in O categories, large Delta_source, source/date instability, attenuation after CRP/BMI/medication/history, dependence on one component or missingness, or a permutation signal. Interpret as common reserve, measured systemic confounding, coding or differential visibility; abandon the organ-specific warning interpretation.

**Inconclusive:** sparse cells, poor overlap, wide intervals, failed calibration/bootstrap, malformed pairing or unresolved provenance. A wide null is not refutation. Continue only with clinical adjudication, encounter/referral/screening dates, complete treatment and nutrition data, imaging/pathology/fibrosis/stage, onset-date adjudication or an external ascertainment-complete cohort.

## 7. Three inspected works

[K1] Sveinbjornsson et al. supports the liver-metabolism rationale and shows why routine enzymes and one-visit measurements are limited; its MRI-PDFF/proteomics are not available here. [K2] Chen et al. supports a plausible prediagnostic inflammation rival but is abstract-only and not a UKB diagnosis-history/source-capture study. [K3] Lu et al. demonstrates the clinical importance of CRC-specific register evidence and complete-population/stage outcomes; those stronger endpoints are unavailable here. The compact bibliography and attached UTF-8 evidence snapshots are in `key-references.json`.

## 8. What computation can and cannot establish

Computation can verify source binding, same-slot parsing, cohort flow, source categories, class-specific contrasts, held-out predictions, calibration, uncertainty and whether conclusions match outputs. It cannot establish true disease incidence/onset, healthcare contact, occult cancer, mechanism, causality, treatment benefit, stage, mortality, clinical utility or generalization. Those claims require expert adjudication, unavailable evidence or another study.

# UKB reserve-to-recorded-CRC timing: a source-concordance and inflammation/nutrition specificity test

Status: proposed, source-bound, and not fitted. This crossover is a substantive successor of candidate-f0914c11c50cfe66051d2bda and candidate-15f22122fb63166d354fe6b2. It retains the CRC branch's full-cohort O0-O4 audit and paired 40005/40006 versus 41270/41280 sensitivity, and adds the C22 branch's measured inflammation/nutrition and liver-pattern rival. It does not claim incidence, complete encounters, true onset, mortality, stage, treatment, mechanism, causality, or clinical benefit.

## 1. Scientific opening, supported claim, and unresolved hypothesis

The strongest available evidence from the parent work is only a conditional recorded-event observation: among people with a valid 2006-2010 assessment and a subsequently observed paired 41270/41280 diagnosis-history event, an assessment-time reserve contrast may be associated with the lag to a first recorded CRC event relative to a first recorded non-cancer event. The parent source audit further supports that two CRC record streams can be compared by their observed dates and code families. These are recorded events, not adjudicated disease onset or encounters.

The unresolved clinical question is whether the apparent near-assessment reserve-to-recorded-CRC timing association is specific to CRC biology, or is explained by measured inflammation/nutrition and differential record visibility. The leading biological interpretation predicts a larger reserve contrast for CRC than for non-cancer and other-cancer records, concentrated in the near window, with similar direction among CRC records concordant across the two available sources. The strongest rival predicts that lower reserve, low albumin/high CRP, the liver-pattern biomarker combination, medication-proxy availability, recent recorded history, or other baseline features change which diagnoses become visible and when. It therefore predicts reserve gradients in O1-O4 source capture, a material change when restricting to O3, and comparable near-lag gradients for non-cancer or other cancer.

[K1] supports frailty/reserve as clinically meaningful in oncology but does not establish prediagnostic CRC timing or UKB source capture. [K2] makes prediagnostic inflammatory change a plausible timing rival but does not measure this reserve or prove a mechanism in this cohort. [K3] demonstrates the stronger evidence a CRC register study can obtain through population-complete linkage and cancer-specific outcomes, which is unavailable here. None establishes the proposed CRC-specific association.

**Hypothesis.** In the eligible assessment population, conditional on the same pre-assessment recorded-history state and available baseline covariates, the lower-versus-higher reserve contrast in the probability that the first observed 41270/41280 event is near the assessment will be larger for CRC than for non-cancer events, and will remain directionally stable when CRC is restricted to O3 records whose first 40005/40006 and 41270/41280 dates are within 30 days. This joint hypothesis is falsified by a comparable non-cancer/other-cancer gradient, a reserve or rival-biomarker gradient in full-cohort source categories, or material attenuation/reversal from all CRC records to O3.

The clinical importance is boundary-setting: a robust, source-stable CRC-specific signal would justify expert adjudication and external validation of a prediagnostic warning hypothesis; a source-shifted or generic signal would redirect effort toward recordability, inflammation/nutrition, and measurement rather than CRC biology. Either result can change the next study. A positive result still establishes only an association among observed diagnosis-history transitions.

## 2. Exact source binding and provenance

The full catalog is the 61-file POPULATION_MULTIOMICS snapshot `ukb-completed-subset-20261002`, catalog SHA-256 `6834d79f6da16d271bd2f4e017feff3648babeb8e3ea41122015757f0adedf32`. The combined binding is recorded in `source-binding-audit.json`. Every join is on `eid) within the `ukb672073` namespace only. The five Parquet derivatives and their corresponding catalog table IDs are:

| role | exact read-only Parquet and SHA-256 | catalog table / raw catalog member | required fields |
|---|---|---|---|
| assessment, reserve inputs, history covariates and medication proxy | `[private-path]/ukb_d61ec821b81b9034.parquet`; `e69705f71f6a4f263371bec081d50a7d9482291d73cde09873634b327936a841` | `UKB/ukb672073_Assessment_Center.csv`; `table-6fc0a334db7f533b`; ordinary file | `eid`, `53-0.0`, `46-0.0`, `47-0.0`, `20116-0.0`, `21001-0.0`, `20003-0.0..20003-0.47` |
| demographics | `[private-path]/ukb_ce68812c3a782e09.parquet`; `d446c8288dfe59abc97e44a43027628aa7221a60f307d4da879a7c491b930299` | `UKB/ukb672073_Population_Characteristics.csv`; `table-674bd55f4152a860`; ordinary file | `eid`, `31-0.0`, `34-0.0`, `21022-0.0` |
| reserve plus inflammation/nutrition/liver-pattern rival | `[private-path]/ukb_a19465be8f90accc.parquet`; `9a62c73361094f4e12045082d8872efa84933e7bb86f596e9e8a49fc162a4ab0` | `UKB/ukb672073_Biological_Samples.csv`; `table-50f94f98137a2d88`; ordinary file | `eid`, `30600-0.0`, `30620-0.0`, `30640-0.0`, `30700-0.0`, `30710-0.0`, `30720-0.0` |
| paired records, first events, and CRC source audit | `[private-path]/ukb_e53f1b242ccf9047.parquet`; `36d0e32efc608dd0e324a6e66fd4211813e7542ec08b78213488ab8f52874ad8` | `UKB/ukb672073_Health_Related_Outcomes.csv`; `table-03f57283ab9ae48b`; ordinary file | `eid`; same-slot `40005-0.0..21.0`/`40006-0.0..21.0`; same-slot `41270-0.0..258.0`/`41280-0.0..258.0` |
| provenance audit only | `[private-path]/ukb_c9f8c514956c9481.parquet`; `42c0e50e9b3e270bb578a4c56f0d753c9a794ad69e56a221bae940dd9060b1d5` | `UKB/ukb672073_Online_Follow_up.csv`; `table-99ff3ee72fc4030a`; ordinary file | `eid`, `20191-0.0`; never a censoring, completeness, encounter, `tau_source`, or denominator field |

The source schemas show 502,370 rows per listed Parquet and the same `ukb672073` identifier namespace. The source catalog, not a bulk-image or recording pointer, is the availability evidence. Source files remain read-only; all audits, derived rows, model objects and outputs are written in the workspace. No UKB-671626, Olink, dta, or other namespace is joined.

## 3. Population, event construction, and fixed timing

Let (b_i) be parsed `53-0.0). Define U before scanning post-assessment events: one row per eid, (2006	ext{-}01	ext{-}01 le b_i le 2010	ext{-}12	ext{-}31), valid sex `31-0.0), age `21022-0.0), BMI `21001-0.0), smoking `20116-0.0), and at least three of four reserve components. Exclude a participant only if either paired cancer stream contains an observed C00-C97 code/date on or before (b_i). This is “no observed pre-assessment cancer record,” never “cancer-free.” Preserve the full U denominator before looking at post-assessment records.

A valid pair has both code and date in the same slot. Parse numeric strings explicitly, normalize ICD-10 strings without inventing prefixes, parse dates, and deduplicate exact code/date pairs. Never borrow a neighboring date, infer an encounter from array order, or let one source manufacture the other source's date.

For the primary event subset E, scan paired 41270/41280 records in ((b_i,b_i+1825	ext{ days}]). Let (t_i) be the earliest valid event date. Classify its first code as CRC (C18, C19, or C20), other cancer (C00-C97 excluding C18-C20), or non-cancer. Flag same-date class ties and exclude them from the primary fit; include them only in the locked tie-inclusion sensitivity. Define L_i=t_i-b_i, near as 0 < L_i < 730 days, and late as 730 <= L_i <= 1825 days. This is a recorded diagnosis-history event and recorded lag, not survival time, incident disease, encounter time, or true onset.

For the full U source-capture audit, scan CRC codes in each source over the same window:

- O0: no CRC record in either source;
- O1: CRC in 41270/41280 only;
- O2: CRC in 40005/40006 only;
- O3: CRC in both, first dates within 30 days;
- O4: CRC in both, first dates differing by more than 30 days.

Report exact-date and +/-30-day concordance, first dates, date difference, and code-family agreement. O0 is not disease-free; it mixes no observed record, unobserved disease and unavailable records. O1-O4 are relative source-capture categories, not sensitivity or truth. The O3 restriction is a sensitivity, not a gold standard. A 40005-only CRC is retained in the audit but cannot manufacture a 41270/41280 non-cancer event. For CRC rows in E, attach O1/O3/O4 where defined; no post-selection source label is used as a primary exposure.

## 4. Reserve, measured rival, and estimands

Construct reserve R using grip_max=max(`46-0.0`, `47-0.0`), albumin `30600-0.0`, creatinine `30700-0.0), and cystatin C `30720-0.0`. On training rows only, use sex-stratified grip standardization, log albumin, negative-log creatinine and negative-log cystatin C; R is the mean of available standardized components. Retain component count and missingness. The primary contrast is R Q25 versus R Q75, with cutpoints fitted on training data only.

The measured rival is prespecified before fitting:

- inflammation/nutrition: log1p(CRP) from `30710-0.0`, albumin level and missingness;
- liver-pattern indicator L2: ApoB `30640-0.0) at or below its training Q25, albumin `30600-0.0) at or below Q25, and ALT `30620-0.0) at or above Q75;
- L1: low ApoB alone, with albumin above Q25 or ALT below Q75;
- medication availability/count: any entry and count across `20003-0.0..20003-0.47), without interpreting codes as statin use, adherence or indication.

Albumin is both a reserve component and part of L2. Therefore report a reserve-without-albumin sensitivity and do not call attenuation mediation. CRP, ALT, ApoB and medication proxies are measured covariates/rivals; their association cannot establish a biological pathway.

For class (g), source stratum (m), and history state (s), estimate the standardized recorded-lag contrast:
[
A_{g,s,m}=P(L<730mid G=g,S=s,M=m,R=Q25)
 -P(L<730mid G=g,S=s,M=m,R=Q75).
]
For non-cancer, M is undefined and all eligible non-cancer events are used. Standardize to the locked U distribution over S and supported baseline covariates X (age, sex, BMI, smoking, calendar year, rival measurements/missingness, and recorded-history variables) with a predeclared overlap rule. Report risk differences, not incidence risks.

The primary cancer-specific quantity is (D_{all}=A_{CRC,all}-A_{NC}). The paired-source sensitivity is (D_{conc}=A_{CRC,O3}-A_{NC}), with O1 and O4 reported separately when supported. The source shift is (Delta_{source}=D_{conc}-D_{all}). Also report CRC versus other-cancer and near versus late contrasts, and the full-U reserve/rival contrasts for O1-O4. The primary decision is locked before fitting:

- **Source-concordant and cancer-specific:** both D_all and D_conc have positive participant-bootstrap 95% lower bounds, D_all-D_NC is positive as defined above, the corresponding other-cancer comparison does not show a comparable gradient, and the 95% interval for (Delta_{source}) lies within the prespecified absolute stability band [-0.05, 0.05]. This supports a recorded-event association surviving the available source audit.
- **Selection/rival explanation:** a reserve/history/rival gradient in O1-O4, a D_conc attenuation beyond that band or reversal, a comparable non-cancer/other-cancer gradient, or collapse after the rival-augmented or reserve-without-albumin sensitivity is adverse to a CRC-specific interpretation. This supports differential visibility or measured inflammation/nutrition as the more plausible explanation, without proving the mechanism.
- **Inconclusive:** support gates fail, intervals are wide or cross the decision boundary, O3 is sparse, calibration/bootstrap fails, or paired parsing/date conflicts remain unresolved. Do not rescue the primary result by changing the window, merging states, or treating an imprecise null as refutation.

## 5. B0/B1 experiment and actual deliverable

The actual deliverable is newly fitted held-out evidence, not a discovery fit: a machine-readable source audit; U flow through O0-O4; paired date/code agreement; support tables; reserve/rival distributions; locked B0 and B1 predictions; calibration and Brier/log loss; standardized D_all, D_conc, Delta_source, CRC-versus-other-cancer/non-cancer contrasts; at least 500 participant-bootstrap intervals; fixed sensitivity outputs; and a conclusion whose claims point to those output files.

Before event modeling, hash `eid` with seed 36 into 70% train, 15% validation and 15% locked test. One eid remains in one split. Fit imputation, transformations, quartiles, standardization weights and tuning only on train/validation; do not inspect locked outcomes for method choice. B0 and B1 use identical rows, labels, engineered X and splits for the O target in U and the event target in E.

**B0 additive baseline.** Fit multinomial logistic regression for O0-O4 in U and a separate multinomial model for event class and near/late status in E. Use additive terms, a restricted age spline, the prespecified reserve-by-history interaction, rival/missingness terms and no data-driven interaction search. Produce standardized probabilities and the estimands from locked predictions. Include a nested reserve-plus-scalar-history ablation and a rival-augmented versus reserve-only comparison.

**B1 substantive shallow learned alternative.** Fit a shallow gradient-boosted multinomial model to exactly the same X, rows, targets and split, using only a fixed validation grid of 200/400 trees, depth 2/3 and learning rate .03/.05. Examine held-out effect tables for O1-O4 and CRC/non-cancer near-lag contrasts. B1 is informative only if nonlinear reserve-by-history-by-source or rival thresholds change the source probabilities or scientific contrasts, remain calibrated on the locked test, and survive source/date and coding sensitivities. A small predictive gain alone is not evidence of CRC biology.

Report locked-test multiclass Brier score, log loss, calibration by O category and event class/near-late category, and one-vs-rest AUC descriptively. Use at least 500 participant-bootstrap resamples with the split preserved. No model can recover undocumented encounters or make source concordance truth.

## 6. Readiness gates and fixed falsification

Before fitting, emit an audit containing exact paths/hashes/table IDs, ordinary-file status, namespace, column presence, paired-slot parseability, malformed code/date counts, duplicates, pre-assessment exclusions, ties, cross-source date/code conflicts, U and O0-O4 counts, reserve/rival missingness, event support, overlap in every split, and confirmation that 20191-0.0 was not used for censoring/completeness. The primary CRC/non-cancer G-by-S-by-near/late cells require at least 30 participants in each required supported cell and nonempty cells in every split. L1/L2 rival summaries require at least 30 relevant observations in each required primary event cell; O3 requires at least 30 CRC observations in each required near/late cell, and O1/O4 each require at least 30 total CRC observations before interpretation. A single fallback may combine S=2 and S=3 as “recent” only if that rule is recorded before checking results and all gates pass.

Fixed checks are: near cutoffs 365 and 730 days and late cutoff 1460 days; exact versus +/-30-day concordance; code-family agreement; tie inclusion; C18-C20 code specificity; complete-four versus minimum-three reserve; reserve-without-albumin; grip-only and laboratory-only reserve; age-only and age-plus-history models; rival adjustment and missingness strata; CRC versus other-cancer/non-cancer comparisons; one within-state event-class permutation; and one fixed source-label permutation among eligible paired CRC records. A permutation signal invalidates the relevant computation. Do not call O0 a negative control or disease-free state.

Supportive result means the gates pass, source-category probabilities show no material reserve/history/rival visibility gradient, D_all and D_conc satisfy the locked source/cancer-specificity rule, the near effect is not matched by non-cancer/other cancer or only late records, concordance is stable, predictions are calibrated, and permutations are null. It supports a robust association among observed records only.

Adverse result means source capture varies with reserve/history/rivals, the O3 contrast attenuates/reverses, generic diagnosis classes show the same pattern, exact/date agreement is unstable, or rival/missingness sensitivities remove the effect. The direction is then recordability/timing or measured inflammation/nutrition, not a CRC-specific biological warning. Inconclusive result means sparse O3/rival cells, wide intervals, failed readiness, malformed pairs, or unsupported calibration. Preserve the audit and seek the next data source rather than alter the estimand.

## 7. Clinical limits and next study

There is no complete encounter/tau_source field here. The 41270/41280 and 40005/40006 dates are recorded events; they do not establish symptom onset, referral, screening, encounter intensity, diagnosis adjudication, incidence, stage, treatment, mortality or causal timing. `20191-0.0` is an online-follow-up field and is not a complete observation boundary. Available proxies do not establish nutrition, inflammation mechanism, liver disease, medication indication/adherence, cirrhosis, alcohol or viral hepatitis status. MRI-PDFF `21088` is present in the broader schema but its usable overlap and date alignment were not verified and it is not used.

Computation can establish parsing, joins, cohort flow, source-category outputs, held-out predictions, calibration, bootstrap uncertainty, sensitivity results and output-linked interpretation. Clinical adjudication, additional encounter-level and screening linkage, validated treatment/medication histories, diagnosis-date review, stage/pathology, mortality provenance, and an independent externally validated cohort are required before claims about true prediagnostic disease, mechanism, clinical prediction, intervention or transportability.

## 8. Inspected key works and evidence boundary

Exactly three distinct works were inspected through the configured Europe PMC route as frozen metadata/abstract responses. All three were inspected abstract-only; no inaccessible full text or supplementary methods is claimed. Their receipts hash the actual attached UTF-8 provider-response bytes in `key-references.json`.

[K1] Mathew D, Lane H, Ward D, Saunders R, Millar L, Etherton-Beer C. “Development and application of a frailty index derived from patient-reported outcome measures and comorbidities in oncology patients.” *Internal Medicine Journal*, 2026. DOI: 10.1111/imj.70599. It supports clinical relevance of reserve/frailty in oncology; it does not establish prediagnostic CRC timing, source capture, or causality.

[K2] Chen G et al. “Age-dependent cytokine surge in blood precedes cancer diagnosis.” *Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America*, 2025. DOI: 10.1073/pnas.2420502122. It supports a plausible prediagnostic inflammatory timing rival; it does not validate CRP/albumin in this UKB binding or distinguish CRC biology from record visibility.

[K3] Lu SSM et al. “Prediagnostic Prescription Antibiotics Use and Survival in Patients with Colorectal Cancer: A Swedish National Register-Based Study.” *Cancer Epidemiology, Biomarkers & Prevention*, 2023. DOI: 10.1158/1055-9965.EPI-23-0340. It bounds the proposed claim by illustrating the population-complete register, cancer-specific outcome and survival evidence unavailable here; it does not test this reserve-to-recorded-lag hypothesis.

Supporting files are `source-binding-audit.json`, `method-alternatives.md`, `key-references.json`, and the three attached Europe PMC response snapshots. No scientific fit result is asserted.

# UKB reserve-to-recorded-CRC timing: a source-concordance and inflammation/nutrition specificity test

Status: proposed, source-bound, and not fitted. This crossover is a substantive successor of candidate-f0914c11c50cfe66051d2bda and candidate-15f22122fb63166d354fe6b2. It retains the CRC branch's full-cohort O0-O4 audit and paired 40005/40006 versus 41270/41280 sensitivity, and adds the C22 branch's measured inflammation/nutrition and liver-pattern rival. It does not claim incidence, complete encounters, true onset, mortality, stage, treatment, mechanism, causality, or clinical benefit.

## 1. Scientific opening, supported claim, and unresolved hypothesis

The strongest available evidence from the parent work is only a conditional recorded-event observation: among people with a valid 2006-2010 assessment and a subsequently observed paired 41270/41280 diagnosis-history event, an assessment-time reserve contrast may be associated with the lag to a first recorded CRC event relative to a first recorded non-cancer event. The parent source audit further supports that two CRC record streams can be compared by their observed dates and code families. These are recorded events, not adjudicated disease onset or encounters.

The unresolved clinical question is whether the apparent near-assessment reserve-to-recorded-CRC timing association is specific to CRC biology, or is explained by measured inflammation/nutrition and differential record visibility. The leading biological interpretation predicts a larger reserve contrast for CRC than for non-cancer and other-cancer records, concentrated in the near window, with similar direction among CRC records concordant across the two available sources. The strongest rival predicts that lower reserve, low albumin/high CRP, the liver-pattern biomarker combination, medication-proxy availability, recent recorded history, or other baseline features change which diagnoses become visible and when. It therefore predicts reserve gradients in O1-O4 source capture, a material change when restricting to O3, and comparable near-lag gradients for non-cancer or other cancer.

[K1] supports frailty/reserve as clinically meaningful in oncology but does not establish prediagnostic CRC timing or UKB source capture. [K2] makes prediagnostic inflammatory change a plausible timing rival but does not measure this reserve or prove a mechanism in this cohort. [K3] demonstrates the stronger evidence a CRC register study can obtain through population-complete linkage and cancer-specific outcomes, which is unavailable here. None establishes the proposed CRC-specific association.

**Hypothesis.** In the eligible assessment population, conditional on the same pre-assessment recorded-history state and available baseline covariates, the lower-versus-higher reserve contrast in the probability that the first observed 41270/41280 event is near the assessment will be larger for CRC than for non-cancer events, and will remain directionally stable when CRC is restricted to O3 records whose first 40005/40006 and 41270/41280 dates are within 30 days. This joint hypothesis is falsified by a comparable non-cancer/other-cancer gradient, a reserve or rival-biomarker gradient in full-cohort source categories, or material attenuation/reversal from all CRC records to O3.

The clinical importance is boundary-setting: a robust, source-stable CRC-specific signal would justify expert adjudication and external validation of a prediagnostic warning hypothesis; a source-shifted or generic signal would redirect effort toward recordability, inflammation/nutrition, and measurement rather than CRC biology. Either result can change the next study. A positive result still establishes only an association among observed diagnosis-history transitions.

The combined binding is recorded in `source-binding-audit.json`. Every join is on `eid` within the `ukb672073` namespace only. ## 3. Population, event construction, and fixed timing

Let b_i be parsed `53-0.0`. Define U before scanning post-assessment events: one row per eid, assessment date from 2006-01-01 through 2010-12-31 inclusive, valid sex `31-0.0`, age `21022-0.0`, BMI `21001-0.0`, smoking `20116-0.0`, and at least three of four reserve components. Exclude a participant only if either paired cancer stream contains an observed C00-C97 code/date on or before b_i. This is “no observed pre-assessment cancer record,” never “cancer-free.” Preserve the full U denominator before looking at post-assessment records.

A valid pair has both code and date in the same slot. Parse numeric strings explicitly, normalize ICD-10 strings without inventing prefixes, parse dates, and deduplicate exact code/date pairs. Never borrow a neighboring date, infer an encounter from array order, or let one source manufacture the other source's date.

For the primary event subset E, scan paired 41270/41280 records after b_i through b_i plus 1825 days. Let t_i be the earliest valid event date. Classify its first code as CRC (C18, C19, or C20), other cancer (C00-C97 excluding C18-C20), or non-cancer. Flag same-date class ties and exclude them from the primary fit; include them only in the locked tie-inclusion sensitivity. Define L_i=t_i-b_i, near as 0 < L_i < 730 days, and late as 730 <= L_i <= 1825 days. This is a recorded diagnosis-history event and recorded lag, not survival time, incident disease, encounter time, or true onset.

For the full U source-capture audit, scan CRC codes in each source over the same window:

- O0: no CRC record in either source;
- O1: CRC in 41270/41280 only;
- O2: CRC in 40005/40006 only;
- O3: CRC in both, first dates within 30 days;
- O4: CRC in both, first dates differing by more than 30 days.

Report exact-date and +/-30-day concordance, first dates, date difference, and code-family agreement. O0 is not disease-free; it mixes no observed record, unobserved disease and unavailable records. O1-O4 are relative source-capture categories, not sensitivity or truth. The O3 restriction is a sensitivity, not a gold standard. A 40005-only CRC is retained in the audit but cannot manufacture a 41270/41280 non-cancer event. For CRC rows in E, attach O1/O3/O4 where defined; no post-selection source label is used as a primary exposure.

## 4. Reserve, measured rival, and estimands

Construct reserve R using grip_max=max(`46-0.0`, `47-0.0`), albumin `30600-0.0`, creatinine `30700-0.0`, and cystatin C `30720-0.0`. On training rows only, use sex-stratified grip standardization, log albumin, negative-log creatinine and negative-log cystatin C; R is the mean of available standardized components. Retain component count and missingness. The primary contrast is R Q25 versus R Q75, with cutpoints fitted on training data only.

The measured rival is prespecified before fitting:

- inflammation/nutrition: log1p(CRP) from `30710-0.0`, albumin level and missingness;
- liver-pattern indicator L2: ApoB `30640-0.0` at or below its training Q25, albumin `30600-0.0` at or below Q25, and ALT `30620-0.0` at or above Q75;
- L1: low ApoB alone, with albumin above Q25 or ALT below Q75;
- medication availability/count: any entry and count across `20003-0.0..20003-0.47`, without interpreting codes as statin use, adherence or indication.

Albumin is both a reserve component and part of L2. Therefore report a reserve-without-albumin sensitivity and do not call attenuation mediation. CRP, ALT, ApoB and medication proxies are measured covariates/rivals; their association cannot establish a biological pathway.

For class g, source stratum m, and history state s, estimate the standardized recorded-lag contrast A(g,s,m) = P(L < 730 | G=g,S=s,M=m,R=Q25) - P(L < 730 | G=g,S=s,M=m,R=Q75).
For non-cancer, M is undefined and all eligible non-cancer events are used. Standardize to the locked U distribution over S and supported baseline covariates X (age, sex, BMI, smoking, calendar year, rival measurements/missingness, and recorded-history variables) with a predeclared overlap rule. Report risk differences, not incidence risks.
The primary cancer-specific quantity is D_all = A_CRC,all - A_NC, where A_NC is the reserve Q25-versus-Q75 near-lag contrast among non-cancer first events. The paired-source sensitivity is D_conc = A_CRC,O3 - A_NC, with O1 and O4 reported separately when supported. The source shift is Delta_source = D_conc - D_all. Also report CRC versus other-cancer and near versus late contrasts, and the full-U reserve/rival contrasts for O1-O4. The primary decision is locked before fitting:
- **Source-concordant and cancer-specific:** both D_all and D_conc have positive participant-bootstrap 95% lower bounds; the CRC-minus-non-cancer contrast is positive by this definition; the corresponding CRC-versus-other-cancer comparison does not show a comparable gradient; and the 95% interval for Delta_source lies within the prespecified absolute stability band [-0.05, 0.05]. This supports a recorded-event association surviving the available source audit.


- **Selection/rival explanation:** a reserve/history/rival gradient in O1-O4, a D_conc attenuation beyond that band or reversal, a comparable non-cancer/other-cancer gradient, or collapse after the rival-augmented or reserve-without-albumin sensitivity is adverse to a CRC-specific interpretation. This supports differential visibility or measured inflammation/nutrition as the more plausible explanation, without proving the mechanism.
- **Inconclusive:** support gates fail, intervals are wide or cross the decision boundary, O3 is sparse, calibration/bootstrap fails, or paired parsing/date conflicts remain unresolved. Do not rescue the primary result by changing the window, merging states, or treating an imprecise null as refutation.

## 5. B0/B1 experiment and actual deliverable

The actual deliverable is newly fitted held-out evidence, not a discovery fit: a machine-readable source audit; U flow through O0-O4; paired date/code agreement; support tables; reserve/rival distributions; locked B0 and B1 predictions; calibration and Brier/log loss; standardized D_all, D_conc, Delta_source, CRC-versus-other-cancer/non-cancer contrasts; at least 500 participant-bootstrap intervals; fixed sensitivity outputs; and a conclusion whose claims point to those output files.

Before event modeling, hash `eid` with seed 36 into 70% train, 15% validation and 15% locked test. One eid remains in one split. Fit imputation, transformations, quartiles, standardization weights and tuning only on train/validation; do not inspect locked outcomes for method choice. B0 and B1 use identical rows, labels, engineered X and splits for the O target in U and the event target in E.

**B0 additive baseline.** Fit multinomial logistic regression for O0-O4 in U and a separate multinomial model for event class and near/late status in E. Use additive terms, a restricted age spline, the prespecified reserve-by-history interaction, rival/missingness terms and no data-driven interaction search. Produce standardized probabilities and the estimands from locked predictions. Include a nested reserve-plus-scalar-history ablation and a rival-augmented versus reserve-only comparison.

**B1 substantive shallow learned alternative.** Fit a shallow gradient-boosted multinomial model to exactly the same X, rows, targets and split, using only a fixed validation grid of 200/400 trees, depth 2/3 and learning rate .03/.05. Examine held-out effect tables for O1-O4 and CRC/non-cancer near-lag contrasts. B1 is informative only if nonlinear reserve-by-history-by-source or rival thresholds change the source probabilities or scientific contrasts, remain calibrated on the locked test, and survive source/date and coding sensitivities. A small predictive gain alone is not evidence of CRC biology.

Report locked-test multiclass Brier score, log loss, calibration by O category and event class/near-late category, and one-vs-rest AUC descriptively. Use at least 500 participant-bootstrap resamples with the split preserved. No model can recover undocumented encounters or make source concordance truth.

## 6. Readiness gates and fixed falsification

Before fitting, emit an audit containing exact paths/hashes/table IDs, ordinary-file status, namespace, column presence, paired-slot parseability, malformed code/date counts, duplicates, pre-assessment exclusions, ties, cross-source date/code conflicts, U and O0-O4 counts, reserve/rival missingness, event support, overlap in every split, and confirmation that 20191-0.0 was not used for censoring/completeness. The primary CRC/non-cancer G-by-S-by-near/late cells require at least 30 participants in each required supported cell and nonempty cells in every split. L1/L2 rival summaries require at least 30 relevant observations in each required primary event cell; O3 requires at least 30 CRC observations in each required near/late cell, and O1/O4 each require at least 30 total CRC observations before interpretation. A single fallback may combine S=2 and S=3 as “recent” only if that rule is recorded before checking results and all gates pass.

Fixed checks are: near cutoffs 365 and 730 days and late cutoff 1460 days; exact versus +/-30-day concordance; code-family agreement; tie inclusion; C18-C20 code specificity; complete-four versus minimum-three reserve; reserve-without-albumin; grip-only and laboratory-only reserve; age-only and age-plus-history models; rival adjustment and missingness strata; CRC versus other-cancer/non-cancer comparisons; one within-state event-class permutation; and one fixed source-label permutation among eligible paired CRC records. A permutation signal invalidates the relevant computation. Do not call O0 a negative control or disease-free state.

Supportive result means the gates pass, source-category probabilities show no material reserve/history/rival visibility gradient, D_all and D_conc satisfy the locked source/cancer-specificity rule, the near effect is not matched by non-cancer/other cancer or only late records, concordance is stable, predictions are calibrated, and permutations are null. It supports a robust association among observed records only.

Adverse result means source capture varies with reserve/history/rivals, the O3 contrast attenuates/reverses, generic diagnosis classes show the same pattern, exact/date agreement is unstable, or rival/missingness sensitivities remove the effect. The direction is then recordability/timing or measured inflammation/nutrition, not a CRC-specific biological warning. Inconclusive result means sparse O3/rival cells, wide intervals, failed readiness, malformed pairs, or unsupported calibration. Preserve the audit and seek the next data source rather than alter the estimand.

## 7. Clinical limits and next study

There is no complete encounter/tau_source field here. The 41270/41280 and 40005/40006 dates are recorded events; they do not establish symptom onset, referral, screening, encounter intensity, diagnosis adjudication, incidence, stage, treatment, mortality or causal timing. `20191-0.0` is an online-follow-up field and is not a complete observation boundary. Available proxies do not establish nutrition, inflammation mechanism, liver disease, medication indication/adherence, cirrhosis, alcohol or viral hepatitis status. MRI-PDFF `21088` is present in the broader schema but its usable overlap and date alignment were not verified and it is not used.

Computation can establish parsing, joins, cohort flow, source-category outputs, held-out predictions, calibration, bootstrap uncertainty, sensitivity results and output-linked interpretation. Clinical adjudication, additional encounter-level and screening linkage, validated treatment/medication histories, diagnosis-date review, stage/pathology, mortality provenance, and an independent externally validated cohort are required before claims about true prediagnostic disease, mechanism, clinical prediction, intervention or transportability.

## 8. Inspected key works and evidence boundary

Exactly three distinct works were inspected through the configured Europe PMC route as frozen metadata/abstract responses. All three were inspected abstract-only; no inaccessible full text or supplementary methods is claimed. Their receipts hash the actual attached UTF-8 provider-response bytes in `key-references.json`.

[K1] Mathew D, Lane H, Ward D, Saunders R, Millar L, Etherton-Beer C. “Development and application of a frailty index derived from patient-reported outcome measures and comorbidities in oncology patients.” *Internal Medicine Journal*, 2026. DOI: 10.1111/imj.70599. It supports clinical relevance of reserve/frailty in oncology; it does not establish prediagnostic CRC timing, source capture, or causality.

[K2] Chen G et al. “Age-dependent cytokine surge in blood precedes cancer diagnosis.” *Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America*, 2025. DOI: 10.1073/pnas.2420502122. It supports a plausible prediagnostic inflammatory timing rival; it does not validate CRP/albumin in this UKB binding or distinguish CRC biology from record visibility.

[K3] Lu SSM et al. “Prediagnostic Prescription Antibiotics Use and Survival in Patients with Colorectal Cancer: A Swedish National Register-Based Study.” *Cancer Epidemiology, Biomarkers & Prevention*, 2023. DOI: 10.1158/1055-9965.EPI-23-0340. It bounds the proposed claim by illustrating the population-complete register, cancer-specific outcome and survival evidence unavailable here; it does not test this reserve-to-recorded-lag hypothesis.

Supporting files are `source-binding-audit.json`, `method-alternatives.md`, `key-references.json`, and the three attached Europe PMC response snapshots. No scientific fit result is asserted.

# UKB reserve-by-recorded-CRC timing: source-replicated contrasts and full-cohort capture audit

Status: proposed successor of candidate-f0914c11c50cfe66051d2bda; source-bound; not fitted. This design preserves the parent's exact `ukb672073` namespace, same-slot event rules, full eligible assessment denominator and recorded-event limits, but changes the primary sensitivity from one O3-concordant subset to two separately estimated source-specific CRC timing contrasts.

## 1. Scientific opening, supported claim and unresolved hypothesis

The strongest claim currently supported by the parent is narrow and conditional: among people with a valid 2006-2010 assessment and a subsequently observed paired diagnosis-history event, assessment-time reserve may be associated with the lag to a first *recorded* CRC diagnosis relative to other recorded diagnoses. The parent also established that the full eligible assessment cohort can be used to describe relative CRC capture in two paired source streams. It did not establish encounter completeness, incidence, mortality, true disease onset, mechanism or causality.

The closest inspected evidence bounds the question rather than answering it. [K1] supports reserve/frailty as clinically meaningful in oncology, but is post-diagnosis and does not study record timing. [K2] makes a biological prediagnostic timing explanation plausible because the abstract reports cytokine changes before cancer diagnosis, but it does not validate this reserve measure or distinguish biological timing from record visibility. [K3] demonstrates what a population-complete register with stage and survival provenance can support, while those evidentiary elements are unavailable here. The three works are therefore motivation and boundary evidence, not proof of the proposed association.

Two explanations remain observationally separable with the available fields:

1. A reserve-related timing pattern is reproducible across independent recorded CRC streams. If so, the reserve-by-near/late contrast should have similar direction and magnitude for the cancer-register stream (40005/40006) and diagnosis-history stream (41270/41280), after the same pre-assessment history standardization. It should not be explained by a large reserve/history gradient in which source records are visible.
2. Differential recorded-source selection or source-specific dating creates the association. This predicts reserve/history gradients in full-cohort source categories, materially different or opposite source-specific timing contrasts, unstable exact versus +/-30-day concordance, or a comparable timing pattern for other recorded cancer/non-cancer classes.

**Hypothesis.** In the full eligible assessment cohort, the reserve-by-near-versus-late contrast among participants with a first recorded CRC in 40005/40006 will agree with the corresponding contrast among participants with a first recorded CRC in 41270/41280. Specifically, after locked standardization over pre-assessment recorded-history state and baseline covariates, both source-specific contrasts will be positive and their difference will lie within a prespecified absolute consistency band of +/-0.05. A full-cohort O0-O4 audit will not show a material reserve/history gradient in relative CRC source capture.

This hypothesis is falsifiable in two directions. A source-heterogeneous result would be scientifically useful: it would identify the observed-record boundary as a consequential explanation that the parent's O3-concordant sensitivity could not distinguish. Even a consistent result would establish only a reproducible association among two recorded sources. It would not identify true disease onset, occult disease, encounter intensity, a biological mechanism, a causal effect or clinical utility.

The clinical importance is boundary-setting for any future use of reserve as a CRC warning or screening-workflow signal. If the pattern is source-replicated and not accompanied by capture gradients, expert review and an adjudicated prospective study become reasonable. If it is source-heterogeneous or capture-dependent, pursuing a biological warning interpretation would be premature.

## 2. Exact source binding, namespace and read-only rule

The frozen snapshot is `ukb-completed-subset-20261002`, catalog SHA-256 `6834d79f6da16d271bd2f4e017feff3648babeb8e3ea41122015757f0adedf32`. The complete machine-readable binding is [source-binding-audit.json](source-binding-audit.json). All joins use only `eid` within `ukb672073`. UKB-671626, Olink and dta identifiers are different namespaces and are not joined. The Parquet sources are read-only; all parsed event tables, audit outputs and model results are derived workspace files.

| Role | Exact Parquet source and SHA-256 | Catalog table / member | Required columns |

| Assessment and reserve | `[private-path]/ukb_d61ec821b81b9034.parquet`; `e69705f71f6a4f263371bec081d50a7d9482291d73cde09873634b327936a841` | `UKB/ukb672073_Assessment_Center.csv (Parquet)`; `table-6fc0a334db7f533b`; ordinary file, no archive member | `eid`, `53-0.0`, `46-0.0`, `47-0.0`, `20116-0.0`, `21001-0.0` |
